==> bench --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                           
                                                                                                    
 The universal environment framework — run, author, and adopt agent benchmarks across any           
 environment.                                                                                       
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --version                       Show the version and exit.                                       │
│ --verbose             -v        Print debug logs, with the traceback of each failed trial (the   │
│                                 same as BENCHFLOW_LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG). Goes before the command:     │
│                                 bench -v run ...                                                 │
│ --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.                        │
│ --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize   │
│                                 the installation.                                                │
│ --help                          Show this message and exit.                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Tasks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ new           Scaffold a new benchmark task.                                                     │
│ check         Validate task structure and the run's plan without starting a sandbox.             │
│ import        Convert task.toml + instruction.md into the unified task.md format.                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Runs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ run           Run an agent on tasks and score them; without -a, the oracle.                      │
│ branch        Fork an agent run at a checkpoint into labelled children.                          │
│ results       Summarize jobs; with two, compare them.                                            │
│ view          View a trial or session trajectory in the browser.                                 │
│ regrade       Re-run the task's current verifier on each trial's frozen workspace.               │
│ export        Export a task to a compatibility split layout with a loss report.                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ This machine ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ doctor        Check this machine can run evals: Python/uv, sandbox, agent credentials, network.  │
│ agents        List the agents, or show one in detail.                                            │
│ explain       Explain why a trial has no score: what happened, whose problem, what next.         │
│ cache         List or clean what BenchFlow keeps: cached layers, build records, snapshots.       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ More ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ eval          Run agents on tasks (smoke, run) and read the results (metrics, view, inspect,     │
│               compare).                                                                          │
│ tasks         Task authoring commands.                                                           │
│ agent         Agent management commands.                                                         │
│ review        Grade finished rollouts against a rubric with a reviewer agent.                    │
│ assess        Blind pairwise human assessments of saved outputs, kept in an opt-in sidecar.      │
│ preferences   Human preferences and rubric scores on finished trials.                            │
│ bundle        Write one zip of a run's evidence to share, redacted.                              │
│ skills        Skill discovery and evaluation.                                                    │
│ traj          Trajectory commands.                                                               │
│ train         Training data commands.                                                            │
│ hub           Environment hubs: browse a hub's environments (list/show/inspect), check registry  │
│               tasks (check), and publish datasets and push runs to a BenchFlow Hub               │
│               (publish/push).                                                                    │
│ daemon        Manage the opt-in warm local runtime.                                              │
│ sandbox       Daytona sandboxes: create, list and clean up (cleanup also removes leftover Docker │
│               containers).                                                                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
                                                                                                    
 New here? Run bench doctor, then follow                                                            
 https://github.com/benchflow-ai/benchflow/blob/main/docs/start/quick-start.md                      
                                                                                                    


==> bench new --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench new [OPTIONS] NAME                                                                    
                                                                                                    
 Scaffold a new benchmark task.                                                                     
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    name      TEXT  Task name [required]                                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --dir                            PATH  Parent directory (default: tasks/) [default: tasks]       │
│ --no-pytest                            Skip pytest template                                      │
│ --no-oracle,--no-solution              Skip oracle template                                      │
│ --format                         TEXT  Task format. New tasks use task-md; legacy scaffolding is │
│                                        retired.                                                  │
│                                        [default: task-md]                                        │
│ --help                                 Show this message and exit.                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench check --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench check [OPTIONS] TASK_DIR                                                              
                                                                                                    
 Validate task structure and the run's plan without starting a sandbox.                             
                                                                                                    
 Warnings (e.g. task.toml keys BenchFlow does not know) are printed                                 
 but do not fail the check.                                                                         
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    task_dir      PATH  Task directory or folder of tasks [required]                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --level                   [schema|structural|runtime-capabil  Validation level: schema,          │
│                           ity|publication-grade|acceptance|a  structural, runtime-capability,    │
│                           cceptance-live|equivalence]         publication-grade, acceptance,     │
│                                                               acceptance-live, or equivalence    │
│                                                               (runs the oracle in --sandbox,     │
│                                                               then grades wrong and              │
│                                                               value-equivalent variants of its   │
│                                                               output)                            │
│                                                               [default: structural]              │
│ --sandbox                 TEXT                                Validate runtime semantics for     │
│                                                               docker, remote-docker, daytona,    │
│                                                               modal, apple-container, or         │
│                                                               agentcore (default: a sandbox that │
│                                                               can run the task: docker, or modal │
│                                                               for a task that asks for GPUs)     │
│ --report-output           PATH                                Write the acceptance-live report   │
│                                                               to this host path instead of the   │
│                                                               task-declared report path; with    │
│                                                               --level equivalence, write the     │
│                                                               battery's JSON report here         │
│ --no-report-write                                             Validate acceptance-live without   │
│                                                               writing the declared report or its │
│                                                               .sha256 sidecar (report-only       │
│                                                               dogfood; leaves the task package   │
│                                                               unmodified). Takes precedence over │
│                                                               --report-output.                   │
│ --allow-task-env          TEXT                                Let tasks read this variable of    │
│                                                               your environment (a ${NAME} env    │
│                                                               value, or their                    │
│                                                               docker-compose.yaml); repeatable.  │
│                                                               A task reading an unnamed one is   │
│                                                               refused; ${NAME:-default} gets the │
│                                                               default                            │
│ --verifier-sandbox        TEXT                                With separate: also check what     │
│                                                               `bench run --verifier-sandbox      │
│                                                               separate` checks before it starts  │
│                                                               (on --sandbox, default docker),    │
│                                                               with the same refusals, and name   │
│                                                               where the verifier image comes     │
│                                                               from                               │
│ --agent                   TEXT                                Agent to validate, as for eval run │
│                                                               [default: claude-agent-acp]        │
│ --model                   TEXT                                Model to validate, as for eval run │
│ --sandbox-user            TEXT                                Agent user to validate, as for     │
│                                                               eval run                           │
│                                                               [default: agent]                   │
│ --help                                                        Show this message and exit.        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

│                          verified                                                                │

╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench run --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench run [OPTIONS] [TARGETS]...                                                            
                                                                                                    
 Run an agent on tasks and score them; without -a, the oracle.                                      
                                                                                                    
 The oracle is the task's reference solution: no model and no key. Rerunning                        
 the same command resumes its job. A run config (--config) is the whole run:                        
 its agent runs unless -a names another, and flags win over its keys.                               
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   targets      [TARGETS]...  A task folder, a folder of tasks, or a GitHub repository (org/repo, │
│                              org/repo/path or org/repo/path@ref); one per run                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent                          -a                      TEXT     The agent: a name `bench       │
│                                                                   agents` lists, or nop (does    │
│                                                                   nothing) (default: oracle, the │
│                                                                   task's reference solution)     │
│ --model                          -m                      TEXT     The model, in the agent's own  │
│                                                                   naming                         │
│ --effort,--reasoning-effort      -e                      TEXT     Reasoning effort, when the     │
│                                                                   agent exposes one (low,        │
│                                                                   medium, high, max, ...)        │
│ --harness                                                TEXT     How the agent runs: acp        │
│                                                                   (default, its ACP adapter) or  │
│                                                                   native (its own CLI in         │
│                                                                   headless JSON mode;            │
│                                                                   claude-agent-acp and           │
│                                                                   codex-acp)                     │
│ --env,--agent-env                                        TEXT     Environment variable for the   │
│                                                                   agent, KEY=VALUE (repeatable)  │
│ --task-skills                        --no-task-skills             Install the task's own skills  │
│                                                                   (environment/skills) for the   │
│                                                                   agent; left out by default, as │
│                                                                   in BenchFlow 0.8               │
│                                                                   [default: no-task-skills]      │
│ --dataset                        -d                      TEXT     A dataset instead of a target: │
│                                                                   name@version from a registry,  │
│                                                                   or org/name@version from a     │
│                                                                   BenchFlow Hub                  │
│ --registry                                               TEXT     The registry for --dataset: a  │
│                                                                   URL, a file or hub:<url>       │
│                                                                   (default: BenchFlow's          │
│                                                                   registry, then                 │
│                                                                   $BENCHFLOW_HUB_URL for an      │
│                                                                   org/name dataset)              │
│ --include                        -i                      TEXT     Only tasks whose names match:  │
│                                                                   a name, or a glob pattern such │
│                                                                   as 'hard-*' (comma-separated   │
│                                                                   or repeated)                   │
│ --exclude                        -x                      TEXT     Skip tasks whose names match   │
│                                                                   (same patterns as --include)   │
│ --limit,--n-tasks                -n                      INTEGER  Run at most N tasks: the first │
│                                                                   N by name, or a seeded random  │
│                                                                   sample with --sample-seed      │
│ --sandbox                        -s                      TEXT     Where trials run: docker,      │
│                                                                   remote-docker, daytona, modal, │
│                                                                   apple-container, or agentcore  │
│ --concurrency                    -j                      INTEGER  Trials running at a time (on   │
│                                                                   Docker, up to --warm-pool more │
│                                                                   are prepared ahead)            │
│ --warm-pool                                              INTEGER  Docker: sandboxes prepared     │
│                                                                   ahead of their trial's turn,   │
│                                                                   beyond the running ones (0 to  │
│                                                                   --concurrency; default 1, or 0 │
│                                                                   at -j 1)                       │
│ --jobs-dir                                               TEXT     Where job folders go (default: │
│                                                                   jobs); a plain rerun resumes   │
│                                                                   its latest job                 │
│ --timeout-multiplier                                     FLOAT    Scale every task's agent       │
│                                                                   timeout, e.g. 2.0              │
│ --idle-timeout,--agent-idle-ti…                          TEXT     Abort a prompt when the agent  │
│                                                                   is silent this long: seconds   │
│                                                                   or 90s, 10m, 1h; 0 or none     │
│                                                                   turns it off (default: 10m,    │
│                                                                   30m at effort xhigh or max)    │
│ --fail-under                                             FLOAT    Exit 1 when the pass rate over │
│                                                                   the planned tasks is below     │
│                                                                   this (0 to 1)                  │
│ --save-outputs,--freeze-worksp…                                   Save each trial's final        │
│                                                                   workspace before the verifier  │
│                                                                   runs, so `bench regrade` can   │
│                                                                   score it again                 │
│ --extra-instruction                                      TEXT     Text appended to every task's  │
│                                                                   instruction                    │
│ --verifier-sandbox                                       TEXT     task or separate. separate     │
│                                                                   runs every task's verifier in  │
│                                                                   a fresh sandbox that gets only │
│                                                                   the workspace and declared     │
│                                                                   artifacts; a task it cannot    │
│                                                                   run there refuses the whole    │
│                                                                   run before anything starts     │
│                                                                   (default: task, each task's    │
│                                                                   own choice)                    │
│ --job,--job-name                                         TEXT     Job name under --jobs-dir (an  │
│                                                                   existing job is resumed)       │
│ --fresh                                                           Start a new job instead of     │
│                                                                   resuming the latest one in     │
│                                                                   --jobs-dir                     │
│ --dry-run                                                         Print the plan as JSON and the │
│                                                                   run card on stderr, and run    │
│                                                                   nothing; for a local folder or │
│                                                                   run config, exits 1 when the   │
│                                                                   run card would refuse the run  │
│ --quiet                          -q                               Print only warnings, errors    │
│                                                                   and the final score            │
│ --config,--run-config                                    PATH     YAML run-config file (the      │
│                                                                   whole run spec)                │
│ --source-repo                                            TEXT     GitHub repo of the tasks as    │
│                                                                   org/repo (e.g.                 │
│                                                                   benchflow-ai/skillsbench)      │
│ --source-path                                            TEXT     Folder in the repo: one task   │
│                                                                   (tasks/econ-detrending-correl… │
│                                                                   or a folder of tasks (tasks).  │
│                                                                   Only this folder is downloaded │
│ --keep-sandbox                                           TEXT     Keep a trial's sandbox:        │
│                                                                   on-failure, always or never    │
│                                                                   (default). `bench sandbox      │
│                                                                   attach <trial>` opens a shell  │
│                                                                   in it; `bench sandbox release  │
│                                                                   <trial>` deletes it.           │
│ --accept-deviations                                      TEXT     Why this run differs from its  │
│                                                                   task set's run-reference.toml  │
│                                                                   (a strict one refuses the run  │
│                                                                   without it); kept in           │
│                                                                   run-card.json.                 │
│ --integrity                                              TEXT     off, audit (record what the    │
│                                                                   agent did and check it against │
│                                                                   the task) or strict (audit,    │
│                                                                   and the verifier in a separate │
│                                                                   sandbox). The verdict is in    │
│                                                                   integrity/claim_verdict.json;  │
│                                                                   rewards never change.          │
│ --max-cost-usd                                           FLOAT    Job budget in USD, checked     │
│                                                                   between starts, so a job can   │
│                                                                   pass it by about one rollout's │
│                                                                   cost; at the cap running       │
│                                                                   rollouts are cancelled. With   │
│                                                                   --trials, each repeat has its  │
│                                                                   own cap                        │
│ --max-tokens                                             INTEGER  Job budget in tokens, checked  │
│                                                                   between starts like            │
│                                                                   --max-cost-usd. With --trials, │
│                                                                   each repeat has its own cap    │
│ --trials                                                 INTEGER  Run every task N times         │
│                                                                   (pass@k); each repeat is a job │
│                                                                   of its own, in <jobs           │
│                                                                   dir>/<agent>/trial-NN          │
│                                                                   [default: 1]                   │
│ --help-all                                                        Show every flag, the run       │
│                                                                   settings --help leaves out     │
│                                                                   included                       │
│ --help                                                            Show this message and exit.    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
                                                                                                    
 85 more run settings (run configs, budgets, hosted environments, checkpoints, publishing): bench   
 run --help-all                                                                                     
                                                                                                    


==> bench branch --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench branch [OPTIONS]                                                                      
                                                                                                    
 Fork an agent run at a checkpoint into labelled children.                                          
                                                                                                    
 Each task runs once up to the checkpoint; the sandbox (and, when asked,                            
 declared environment state) is snapshotted; every --child starts from                              
 that snapshot with a fresh agent session (child prompts must stand                                 
 alone unless --resume-session reloads the parent's conversation) and is                            
 scored by the task's verifier. The job folder has the usual layout plus, per trial, tree.json      
 and branches/<fork>/children/<node>/observation.json.                                              
                                                                                                    
 Example:                                                                                           
                                                                                                    
     bench branch --tasks-dir tasks/my-task                                                         
     --agent claude-agent-acp --sandbox daytona                                                     
     --prompt "Write draft.txt containing: Hello world"                                             
     --prompt @instruction --checkpoint-after-prompt 1                                              
     --child "label=baseline" --child "label=hint,prompt=Rename draft.txt."                         
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks-dir                        PATH                  A task directory, or a directory of     │
│                                                          tasks (run one after another).          │
│ --agent                            TEXT                  Agent name, or 'oracle' (children run   │
│                                                          the task's solve.sh). Default: the      │
│                                                          checkpoint's agent with                 │
│                                                          --from-checkpoint, else                 │
│                                                          claude-agent-acp.                       │
│ --model                    -m      TEXT                  Model id for the agent, e.g.            │
│                                                          claude-haiku-5-5 (none for oracle and   │
│                                                          nop)                                    │
│ --reasoning-effort                 TEXT                  Agent reasoning effort (e.g. max)       │
│ --harness                          TEXT                  How the agent runs: acp (default, its   │
│                                                          ACP adapter) or native (its own CLI in  │
│                                                          headless JSON mode; claude-agent-acp    │
│                                                          and codex-acp)                          │
│ --sandbox                          TEXT                  docker or daytona (Daytona direct mode  │
│                                                          snapshots). Default: docker, or the     │
│                                                          checkpoint's provider.                  │
│ --prompt                           TEXT                  Parent prompt; repeatable, sent in      │
│                                                          order. '@instruction' is the task's     │
│                                                          instruction. Default: the task's        │
│                                                          prompts.                                │
│ --checkpoint-after-prompt          INTEGER               Branch after this many parent prompts   │
│                                                          (0: before the first). Default 1; 0 for │
│                                                          the oracle and with --from-checkpoint.  │
│ --child                            TEXT                  One child, as                           │
│                                                          label=NAME[,parent=LABEL][,prompt=TEXT… │
│                                                          give at least two. prompt= takes the    │
│                                                          rest of the option (commas allowed).    │
│                                                          parent=LABEL forks this child from      │
│                                                          child LABEL's state after LABEL has run │
│                                                          its prompts (a nested fork of at least  │
│                                                          two children). Without a prompt the     │
│                                                          child runs the parent's remaining       │
│                                                          prompts, or the task's prompts when the │
│                                                          checkpoint is after the last one.       │
│ --snapshot-layers                  TEXT                  What the checkpoint captures: sandbox   │
│                                                          (container filesystem), environment     │
│                                                          (declared database state, needs a       │
│                                                          manifest), or both.                     │
│                                                          [default: sandbox]                      │
│ --parent                           TEXT                  continue: restore the parent world      │
│                                                          after the children, send the remaining  │
│                                                          prompts and verify. discard: skip that  │
│                                                          restore (one fewer), leave the parent   │
│                                                          unverified. Default: continue, or       │
│                                                          discard with --from-checkpoint.         │
│ --retain-snapshots                                       Keep the checkpoint's sandbox snapshot  │
│                                                          so a later --from-checkpoint can branch │
│                                                          from it again (otherwise deleted).      │
│                                                          `bench sandbox cleanup` removes kept    │
│                                                          Daytona snapshots once stale.           │
│ --from-checkpoint                  PATH                  A trial folder from an earlier `bench   │
│                                                          branch --retain-snapshots` run: branch  │
│                                                          again from its kept sandbox snapshot.   │
│                                                          Needs --tasks-dir holding the same      │
│                                                          task.                                   │
│ --fork,--checkpoint                TEXT                  With --from-checkpoint: a fork id from  │
│                                                          tree.json or an automatic checkpoint as │
│                                                          prompt:N (default: the last kept fork,  │
│                                                          else the last kept checkpoint).         │
│ --checkpoints                      TEXT                  Also keep a sandbox snapshot after      │
│                                                          these parent prompts (every-prompt or   │
│                                                          prompt:N[,M]) for a later               │
│                                                          --from-checkpoint.                      │
│ --checkpoint-keep                  INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Keep at most this many --checkpoints    │
│                                                          per trial.                              │
│                                                          [default: 3]                            │
│ --resume-session                                         Children resume the parent's agent      │
│                                                          conversation (ACP session/load) instead │
│                                                          of starting fresh, so a child prompt    │
│                                                          can say 'continue'. Needs an agent that │
│                                                          advertises loadSession and keeps its    │
│                                                          session on disk (Claude Code), and a    │
│                                                          checkpoint after prompt 1+.             │
│ --child-retries                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=0]  Retry a child this many times when it   │
│                                                          failed before its agent did anything (a │
│                                                          provider hiccup such as a connect       │
│                                                          timeout).                               │
│                                                          [default: 1]                            │
│ --stop-on-child-failure                                  Stop a fork at the first child that     │
│                                                          fails for good (default: the other      │
│                                                          children still run and the fork is      │
│                                                          partial).                               │
│ --concurrency                      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Run up to this many children of a fork  │
│                                                          at once, each in its own sandbox        │
│                                                          created from the snapshot (implies      │
│                                                          --isolate-children).                    │
│                                                          [default: 1]                            │
│ --isolate-children                                       Run each child in its own sandbox       │
│                                                          created from the snapshot instead of    │
│                                                          restoring the parent's sandbox between  │
│                                                          children. Implied by --concurrency > 1  │
│                                                          and by nested children.                 │
│ --agent-env                        TEXT                  Agent env var (KEY=VALUE); repeatable   │
│ --include                          TEXT                  Only these task names; repeatable       │
│ --jobs-dir                         PATH                  Output directory [default: jobs]        │
│ --job-name                         TEXT                  Job folder name (default:               │
│                                                          branch-<time>)                          │
│ --help                                                   Show this message and exit.             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench results --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench results [OPTIONS] [JOBS]...                                                           
                                                                                                    
 Summarize jobs; with two, compare them.                                                            
                                                                                                    
 With no job, or a folder of jobs, it lists the jobs (`bench eval list`);                           
 with one, it reads the job (`bench eval inspect`); with two, it pairs them                         
 by task (`bench eval compare`).                                                                    
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   jobs      [JOBS]...  Job folders, or a folder of jobs (default: ./jobs); one job is read trial │
│                        by trial, two are compared task by task                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json                          Print the benchflow.job document (one job) or the                │
│                                 benchflow.comparison document (two)                              │
│ --attempts                TEXT  best (one attempt per task, as resume picks) or all              │
│                                 [default: best]                                                  │
│ --include-controls              Count control runs (oracle, empty) in the denominators           │
│ --by                      TEXT  One job: also count per group, e.g. agent,model; two: pair on    │
│                                 these keys too                                                   │
│ --help                          Show this message and exit.                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench regrade --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench regrade [OPTIONS] PATH                                                                
                                                                                                    
 Re-run the task's current verifier on each trial's frozen workspace.                               
                                                                                                    
 The new score is written beside the original (regrade.json in each trial,                          
 regrade-summary.json in PATH); result.json is never changed. Trials whose                          
 workspace was not frozen (--freeze-workspace) are listed as not regradable.                        
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  A job folder, or one trial folder inside it [required]                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks-dir                        PATH                  Folder of task folders (or one task     │
│                                                          folder) holding the changed verifiers.  │
│                                                          Default: the task path each trial       │
│                                                          recorded.                               │
│ --sandbox                          TEXT                  Backend for the fresh sandboxes         │
│                                                          (default: as run)                       │
│ --concurrency                      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Trials regraded at once [default: 4]    │
│ --reason                           TEXT                  Why the verifier changed; kept in each  │
│                                                          block                                   │
│ --json                                                   Print the summary as JSON               │
│ --review                                                 Also rerun each trial's rubric review   │
│                                                          on its saved outputs, gated by the new  │
│                                                          test, and compare the combined score.   │
│                                                          The reviewer is the one the trial       │
│                                                          recorded, changed by --reviewer-*       │
│ --reviewer-agent                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer harness                 │
│ --reviewer-model                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer model                   │
│ --reviewer-reasoning-effort        TEXT                  Rubric reviewer reasoning effort        │
│ --reviewer-sandbox                 TEXT                  Rubric reviewer sandbox backend         │
│ --reviewer-timeout-sec             INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer execution budget in seconds    │
│ --reviewer-idle-timeout            TEXT                  Abort a reviewer prompt after this many │
│                                                          idle seconds (default: 600). Pass 0 or  │
│                                                          'none' to disable the idle watchdog and │
│                                                          leave --reviewer-timeout-sec in charge. │
│ --reviewer-storage-mb              INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox disk in MB (default:   │
│                                                          the evidence it holds plus 2048, at     │
│                                                          least 4096, at most the sandbox         │
│                                                          backend's limit)                        │
│ --reviewer-memory-mb               INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox memory in MB (default: │
│                                                          2048)                                   │
│ --reviewer-setup-timeout           INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds for the reviewer sandbox's      │
│                                                          setup, its model proxy install among it │
│                                                          (default: the run's                     │
│                                                          --sandbox-setup-timeout)                │
│ --reviewer-evidence-timeout        INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds to unpack, and again to check,  │
│                                                          the workspace evidence in the reviewer  │
│                                                          sandbox (default: 1 per MiB, at least   │
│                                                          600)                                    │
│ --reviewer-concurrency             INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Max concurrent rubric reviewers         │
│ --reviewer-image                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer container image         │
│ --reviewer-agent-env               TEXT                  Reviewer environment variable           │
│                                                          (KEY=VALUE)                             │
│ --reviewer-open-network                                  Allow unrestricted reviewer network     │
│                                                          access                                  │
│ --help                                                   Show this message and exit.             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench doctor --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench doctor [OPTIONS]                                                                      
                                                                                                    
 Check this machine can run evals: Python/uv, sandbox, agent credentials, network.                  
                                                                                                    
 Credentials are reported by name, source and expiry only; values are                               
 never printed. Exits 1 when a required check fails.                                                
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --sandbox            TEXT  Sandbox the checks treat as required: docker (default), remote-docker │
│                            or daytona. Others are listed but not checked yet.                    │
│                            [default: docker]                                                     │
│ --offline                  Skip network probes and the live Daytona credential check.            │
│ --json                     Print the report as JSON.                                             │
│ --agent-start        TEXT  Also install this agent in a fresh --sandbox and open its ACP         │
│                            connection without a prompt (no model call), to catch a broken        │
│                            install or login before a batch (repeatable).                         │
│ --help                     Show this message and exit.                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench explain --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench explain [OPTIONS] [CODE]                                                              
                                                                                                    
 Explain why a trial has no score: what happened, whose problem, what next.                         
                                                                                                    
 The code is the one the run summary names; without one, every code is listed.                      
                                                                                                    
 Examples:                                                                                          
                                                                                                    
     bench explain                    # every code                                                  
     bench explain R212               # the model provider refused the credential                   
     bench explain verifier_failure --json                                                          
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   code      [CODE]  The code the run summary names, such as R212 or verifier_failure (omit to    │
│                     list every code).                                                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json          Print the page, or the list, as JSON.                                            │
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench cache --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench cache [OPTIONS] [COMMAND] [ARGS]...                                                   
                                                                                                    
 List or clean what BenchFlow keeps: cached layers, build records, snapshots.                       
                                                                                                    
 Without a command, lists (as `bench cache list`).                                                  
                                                                                                    
 Examples:                                                                                          
   bench cache list --only images -s docker   # cached layers on Docker                             
   bench cache clean --older-than 30d         # what would go                                       
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --only                KINDS     Only these kinds: images, build-cache, pulled-images             │
│                                 (comma-separated or repeated; default: images and build-cache)   │
│ --sandbox     -s      BACKEND   docker or daytona (default: docker when installed, daytona when  │
│                                 DAYTONA_API_KEY is set); daytona lists this                      │
│                                 BENCHFLOW_DAYTONA_OWNER's content snapshots                      │
│ --older-than          DURATION  Only what was created longer ago than this (e.g. 30d, 12h); the  │
│                                 age is the creation time, not the last use                       │
│ --json                          Print JSON on stdout; notes go to stderr                         │
│ --help                          Show this message and exit.                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ list    List what BenchFlow keeps, with sizes and creation times (the default).                  │
│ clean   Print what would be removed; remove it with --remove.                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Usage: bench cache list [OPTIONS]

 Nothing is removed or tagged.

│                                 DAYTONA_API_KEY is set); daytona lists this                      │
│                                 BENCHFLOW_DAYTONA_OWNER's content snapshots                      │
│ --older-than          DURATION  Only what was created longer ago than this (e.g. 30d, 12h); the  │
│                                 age is the creation time, not the last use                       │

==> bench cache clean --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench cache clean [OPTIONS]                                                                 
                                                                                                    
 Print what would be removed; remove it with --remove.                                              
                                                                                                    
 What something still uses stays, with the reason.                                                  
                                                                                                    
 Examples:                                                                                          
   bench cache clean                            # what would be removed                             
   bench cache clean --only images --remove     # remove idle cached layers                         
   bench cache clean --only pulled-images --remove                                                  
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --only                KINDS     Only these kinds: images, build-cache, pulled-images             │
│                                 (comma-separated or repeated; default: images and build-cache)   │
│ --sandbox     -s      BACKEND   docker or daytona (default: docker when installed, daytona when  │
│                                 DAYTONA_API_KEY is set); daytona lists this                      │
│                                 BENCHFLOW_DAYTONA_OWNER's content snapshots                      │
│ --older-than          DURATION  Only what was created longer ago than this (e.g. 30d, 12h); the  │
│                                 age is the creation time, not the last use                       │
│ --json                          Print JSON on stdout; notes go to stderr                         │
│ --remove                        Remove what is listed; without it, nothing is removed            │
│ --help                          Show this message and exit.                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                      
                                                                                                    
 Run agents on tasks (smoke, run) and read the results (metrics, view, inspect, compare).           
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ smoke          Run a bundled hello-world task once per credentialed agent, one at a time.        │
│ run            Run an evaluation — single task or batch. (old name of `bench run`)               │
│ adopt          Adopt an external benchmark into benchflow.                                       │
│ compare-lift   Compare paired baseline vs trained eval job directories.                          │
│ score          Retry a failed reviewer using the saved workspace and trajectory.                 │
│ regrade        Re-run the task's current verifier on each trial's frozen workspace. (old name of │
│                `bench regrade`)                                                                  │
│ list           List the jobs in a jobs folder, one row each, with their scores. (old name of     │
│                `bench results`)                                                                  │
│ metrics        Collect and display metrics from a jobs directory.                                │
│ view           View a trial or session trajectory in the browser. (old name of `bench view`)     │
│ continue       Resume a previous unfinished (timed-out) OpenHands run to completion.             │
│ branch         Fork an agent run at a checkpoint into labelled children. (old name of `bench     │
│                branch`)                                                                          │
│ inspect        Read a finished job or trial: denominators, one row per trial, or --json. (old    │
│                name of `bench results`)                                                          │
│ compare        Pair two jobs by task: rewards, deltas, fair denominators, setting checks. (old   │
│                name of `bench results`)                                                          │
│ resume         Finish an interrupted job from its folder: rerun only the unfinished tasks.       │
│ branches       Show every fork and child of a job's (or one trial's) branches:                   │
│                request, status, reward, advantage, tokens, USD and sandbox-seconds.              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval smoke --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval smoke [OPTIONS]                                                                  
                                                                                                    
 Run a bundled hello-world task once per credentialed agent, one at a time.                         
                                                                                                    
 Checks the machine first (as `bench doctor`), then runs each agent in                              
 its own `bench eval run`, prints agent, reward, time and trajectory                                
 path, and exits 1 unless every run scores 1.0.                                                     
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent              TEXT                   Agent to smoke, as NAME or NAME=MODEL; repeatable.   │
│                                             Default: every agent `bench doctor` found a working  │
│                                             credential for (claude, codex, gemini).              │
│ --sandbox            TEXT                   Sandbox: docker (default) or daytona.                │
│                                             [default: docker]                                    │
│ --jobs-dir           PATH                   Parent directory; each smoke writes a timestamped    │
│                                             folder here.                                         │
│                                             [default: jobs/smoke]                                │
│ --timeout-sec        INTEGER RANGE [x>=60]  Kill a run that takes longer than this many seconds. │
│                                             [default: 900]                                       │
│ --help                                      Show this message and exit.                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval run --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval run [OPTIONS]                                                                    
                                                                                                    
 Run an evaluation — single task or batch.                                                          
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --config,--run-config                     PATH                  YAML run-config file (the whole  │
│                                                                 run spec)                        │
│ --tasks-dir                               PATH                  Local tasks directory            │
│ --source-repo                             TEXT                  GitHub repo of the tasks as      │
│                                                                 org/repo (e.g.                   │
│                                                                 benchflow-ai/skillsbench)        │
│ --source-path                             TEXT                  Folder in the repo: one task     │
│                                                                 (tasks/econ-detrending-correlat… │
│                                                                 or a folder of tasks (tasks).    │
│                                                                 Only this folder is downloaded   │
│ --source-ref                              TEXT                  Branch, tag or full commit SHA   │
│                                                                 to fetch (e.g. main)             │
│ --source-env                              TEXT                  Hosted environment source (e.g.  │
│                                                                 primeintellect/general-agent)    │
│ --source-env-version                      TEXT                  Hosted environment version       │
│ --source-env-arg                          TEXT                  Hosted environment arg as        │
│                                                                 KEY=VALUE; repeatable            │
│ --source-env-num-examples                 INTEGER               Number of env examples           │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --source-env-rollouts-per-examp…          INTEGER               Rollouts per hosted env example  │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --source-env-max-tokens                   INTEGER               Max tokens for hosted env run    │
│                                                                 [default: 1024]                  │
│ --source-env-temperature                  FLOAT                 Temperature for hosted env run   │
│                                                                 (default: none sent, so the      │
│                                                                 provider's own)                  │
│ --source-env-sampling-arg                 TEXT                  Hosted env sampling arg as       │
│                                                                 KEY=VALUE; repeatable (e.g.      │
│                                                                 reasoning_effort=minimal)        │
│ --source-env-verifiers-version            TEXT                  Pin the verifiers release        │
│                                                                 installed with the hosted env    │
│                                                                 (default: the env package's own  │
│                                                                 requirement)                     │
│ --source-env-base-url                     TEXT                  Model endpoint for the hosted    │
│                                                                 env run (default: verifiers'     │
│                                                                 own, Prime inference with        │
│                                                                 PRIME_API_KEY)                   │
│ --source-env-api-key-var                  TEXT                  Name of the environment variable │
│                                                                 holding that endpoint's API key  │
│ --agent                           -a      TEXT                  Agent: claude, codex, gemini,    │
│                                                                 ... (bench agents), oracle (the  │
│                                                                 task's reference solution) or    │
│                                                                 nop (does nothing)               │
│ --model                           -m      TEXT                  Model id for the agent, e.g.     │
│                                                                 claude-haiku-5-5 (none for       │
│                                                                 oracle and nop)                  │
│ --reasoning-effort                        TEXT                  Agent reasoning/thinking effort  │
│                                                                 when the agent exposes one (e.g. │
│                                                                 max)                             │
│ --harness                                 TEXT                  How the agent runs: acp          │
│                                                                 (default, its ACP adapter) or    │
│                                                                 native (its own CLI in headless  │
│                                                                 JSON mode; claude-agent-acp and  │
│                                                                 codex-acp)                       │
│ --sandbox                         -s      TEXT                  Sandbox: docker, remote-docker,  │
│                                                                 daytona, modal, apple-container, │
│                                                                 or agentcore                     │
│ --usage-tracking                          TEXT                  Telemetry-enforcement policy:    │
│                                                                 auto, required, or off. The      │
│                                                                 LiteLLM proxy is always used for │
│                                                                 routable agents (usage, cost,    │
│                                                                 and llm_trajectory.jsonl are     │
│                                                                 always captured); this flag only │
│                                                                 controls whether trusted         │
│                                                                 telemetry is required.           │
│ --environment-manifest                    PATH                  Environment-plane manifest       │
│                                                                 applied to every rollout: a path │
│                                                                 to an environment.toml, OR a     │
│                                                                 'name@version' registry spec     │
│                                                                 resolved via                     │
│                                                                 $BENCHFLOW_ENV_REGISTRY when     │
│                                                                 set, else the built-in registry  │
│                                                                 shipped with benchflow           │
│                                                                 (env0@prod, env0@outage). The    │
│                                                                 manifest-declared stateful       │
│                                                                 environment is provisioned,      │
│                                                                 gated on readiness, and torn     │
│                                                                 down.                            │
│ --state                                   TEXT                  The stateful environment to      │
│                                                                 bind, apart from the task.       │
│                                                                 Inline JSON with an optional     │
│                                                                 tool subset (e.g. {"name":       │
│                                                                 "env0", "tools": ["gmail",       │
│                                                                 "gcal"]}), OR a name@version     │
│                                                                 spec, OR a manifest path. Takes  │
│                                                                 precedence over                  │
│                                                                 --environment-manifest.          │
│ --prompt                                  TEXT                  Prompt(s) to send (default: the  │
│                                                                 task prompt: the task.md body,   │
│                                                                 or instruction.md for older      │
│                                                                 tasks)                           │
│ --config-override                         TEXT                  Deep-merge a config patch into   │
│                                                                 each task's resolved config for  │
│                                                                 this run. Inline JSON/YAML/TOML  │
│                                                                 or an @file ref, e.g.            │
│                                                                 --config-override                │
│                                                                 '{"agent":{"timeout_sec":120}}'. │
│                                                                 Varies one knob (budget, skills, │
│                                                                 stopping rules) while the tasks, │
│                                                                 agent, model and environment     │
│                                                                 stay fixed; recorded by content  │
│                                                                 hash for replay.                 │
│ --concurrency                     -j      INTEGER               Trials running at a time. On     │
│                                                                 Docker a job also prepares up to │
│                                                                 --warm-pool sandboxes ahead      │
│                                                                 (default 1 when this is 2 or     │
│                                                                 more)                            │
│ --build-concurrency                       INTEGER               Max concurrent docker image      │
│                                                                 builds. Defaults to              │
│                                                                 --concurrency. Set lower (e.g.   │
│                                                                 8) when --concurrency is high to │
│                                                                 avoid overwhelming the docker    │
│                                                                 daemon with parallel builds.     │
│ --warm-pool                               INTEGER               Docker: how many sandboxes to    │
│                                                                 prepare ahead of their trial's   │
│                                                                 turn, beyond the --concurrency   │
│                                                                 running ones (0 to               │
│                                                                 --concurrency; default 1, or 0   │
│                                                                 when --concurrency is 1)         │
│ --worker-concurrency                      INTEGER               Run batch eval through isolated  │
│                                                                 worker subprocesses, each with   │
│                                                                 at most this many concurrent     │
│                                                                 tasks; --concurrency remains the │
│                                                                 aggregate target.                │
│ --worker-retries                          INTEGER               Retry a crashed worker shard     │
│                                                                 this many times, resuming its    │
│                                                                 jobs_dir.                        │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --worker-start-stagger-sec                FLOAT                 Seconds to stagger worker starts │
│                                                                 to avoid Daytona connection      │
│                                                                 storms.                          │
