│                                                                 [default: 1.0]                   │
│ --agent-idle-timeout,--idle-tim…          TEXT                  Abort a prompt when the agent is │
│                                                                 silent this long: seconds, or    │
│                                                                 90s, 10m, 1h; 0, none or null    │
│                                                                 turns it off and leaves the      │
│                                                                 task's wall-clock timeout        │
│                                                                 (default: 10m, 30m at effort     │
│                                                                 xhigh or max)                    │
│ --checkpoints                             TEXT                  Keep a sandbox snapshot after    │
│                                                                 these prompts: every-prompt or   │
│                                                                 prompt:N[,M]. Later `bench       │
│                                                                 branch --from-checkpoint         │
│                                                                 <trial>` forks from one. Docker, │
│                                                                 or Daytona direct; each is a     │
│                                                                 full filesystem image. See       │
│                                                                 docs/train/environment.md        │
│ --checkpoint-keep                         INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Keep at most this many           │
│                                                                 checkpoints per trial (default   │
│                                                                 3, or a run config's             │
│                                                                 checkpoint_keep); the oldest is  │
│                                                                 deleted.                         │
│ --freeze-workspace                                              Save each trial's final          │
│                                                                 workspace and declared artifacts │
│                                                                 (evidence/, with a manifest)     │
│                                                                 before the verifier runs, so     │
│                                                                 `bench regrade` can re-score it  │
│                                                                 with a changed verifier.         │
│ --keep-sandbox                            TEXT                  Keep a trial's sandbox:          │
│                                                                 on-failure, always or never      │
│                                                                 (default). `bench sandbox attach │
│                                                                 <trial>` opens a shell in it;    │
│                                                                 `bench sandbox release <trial>`  │
│                                                                 deletes it.                      │
│ --accept-deviations                       TEXT                  Why this run differs from its    │
│                                                                 task set's run-reference.toml (a │
│                                                                 strict one refuses the run       │
│                                                                 without it); kept in             │
│                                                                 run-card.json.                   │
│ --fresh-install                                                 Install the model proxy and the  │
│                                                                 agent in every trial instead of  │
│                                                                 starting from their cached image │
│                                                                 layers (same as                  │
│                                                                 BENCHFLOW_FRESH_INSTALL=1)       │
│ --allow-cloud-metadata                                          Let the agent reach the cloud    │
│                                                                 metadata endpoints under an open │
│                                                                 network (no block; each trial    │
│                                                                 records the opt-out). Without    │
│                                                                 it, or the task's                │
│                                                                 allow_cloud_metadata = true, the │
│                                                                 agent starts only once the block │
│                                                                 is proven on                     │
│ --integrity                               TEXT                  off, audit (record what the      │
│                                                                 agent did and check it against   │
│                                                                 the task) or strict (audit, and  │
│                                                                 the verifier in a separate       │
│                                                                 sandbox). The verdict is in      │
│                                                                 integrity/claim_verdict.json;    │
│                                                                 rewards never change.            │
│ --verifier-sandbox                        TEXT                  task (default: each task's own   │
│                                                                 choice) or separate: every       │
│                                                                 verifier in a fresh sandbox with │
│                                                                 only the workspace and the       │
│                                                                 declared artifacts; a task that  │
│                                                                 cannot run there refuses the     │
│                                                                 run.                             │
│ --retry-from-checkpoint                   TEXT                  on-failure, on-timeout, or both: │
│                                                                 when a trial fails or times out, │
│                                                                 fork one retry from its last     │
│                                                                 --checkpoints snapshot, verified │
│                                                                 the same way. The trial's reward │
│                                                                 is kept; the retry's is reported │
│                                                                 next to it (result.json retry    │
│                                                                 block, summary                   │
│                                                                 checkpoint_retries).             │
│ --retry-prompt                            TEXT                  Prompt for the retry, replacing  │
│                                                                 the prompts after the checkpoint │
│                                                                 (the default). '@instruction' is │
│                                                                 the task instruction,            │
│                                                                 '@verifier_feedback' the failed  │
│                                                                 trial's reward and verifier      │
│                                                                 output tail.                     │
│ --max-cost-usd                            FLOAT                 Job budget in USD, checked       │
│                                                                 between starts, so a job can     │
│                                                                 pass it by about one rollout's   │
│                                                                 cost; at the cap running         │
│                                                                 rollouts are cancelled. With     │
│                                                                 --trials, each repeat has its    │
│                                                                 own cap                          │
│ --max-sandbox-seconds                     FLOAT                 Job budget in trial wall-clock   │
│                                                                 seconds, running trials included │
│                                                                 and re-checked as they run; same │
│                                                                 stop/cancel behaviour as         │
│                                                                 --max-cost-usd                   │
│ --max-tokens                              INTEGER               Job budget in tokens, checked    │
│                                                                 between starts like              │
│                                                                 --max-cost-usd. With --trials,   │
│                                                                 each repeat has its own cap      │
│ --max-rollouts                            INTEGER               Job budget in rollouts started,  │
│                                                                 retries included: at the cap no  │
│                                                                 rollout starts and running ones  │
│                                                                 finish                           │
│ --token-budget                            INTEGER               Per-trial budget in tokens       │
│                                                                 (input, cached included, plus    │
│                                                                 output), subagents' calls        │
│                                                                 included: BenchFlow's model      │
│                                                                 proxy refuses the next model     │
│                                                                 call once it is spent, the agent │
│                                                                 is stopped and its work graded.  │
│                                                                 Replaces a task's  token_budget  │
│ --turn-budget                             INTEGER               Per-trial budget in turns, one   │
│                                                                 turn being one model call        │
│                                                                 through BenchFlow's model proxy  │
│                                                                 (subagents' and side calls       │
│                                                                 included); enforced like         │
│                                                                 --token-budget. Replaces a       │
│                                                                 task's  turn_budget              │
│ --retry-resume-session                                          The retry resumes the failed     │
│                                                                 trial's conversation at the      │
│                                                                 checkpoint (ACP session/load;    │
│                                                                 Claude Code) instead of a fresh  │
│                                                                 session.                         │
│ --quiet                                                         Print only warnings, errors and  │
│                                                                 the final score: no Rich         │
│                                                                 dashboard on a TTY, no progress  │
│                                                                 heartbeat (the '… Nmin, K tool   │
│                                                                 calls' lines) and no per-trial   │
│                                                                 log lines                        │
│ --jobs-dir                                TEXT                  Output directory (default jobs); │
│                                                                 a plain run resumes its latest   │
│                                                                 job                              │
│ --fresh                                                         Start a new timestamped job      │
│                                                                 instead of resuming the latest   │
│                                                                 job in --jobs-dir (the default   │
│                                                                 reuses its finished tasks)       │
│ --job-name                                TEXT                  Job folder name under --jobs-dir │
│                                                                 (resumed if it exists)           │
│ --restart-changed                                               When the named job ran with      │
│                                                                 other settings or task files,    │
│                                                                 set those trials aside and run   │
│                                                                 them again (default: refuse)     │
│ --fail-under                              FLOAT                 Exit 1 when the pass rate        │
│                                                                 (passed / planned tasks; one a   │
│                                                                 budget kept from running counts  │
│                                                                 as not passed) is below this,    │
│                                                                 e.g. 0.8                         │
│ --fail-on                                 TEXT                  Exit 1 when any trial ended this │
│                                                                 way: timeout, error,             │
│                                                                 verifier-error (comma-separated  │
│                                                                 or repeated)                     │
│ --summary-out                             PATH                  Write the run's                  │
│                                                                 benchflow.run-summary JSON (job  │
│                                                                 dir, counts, gate) here          │
│ --codex-apps-policy                       TEXT                  Codex account Apps: disabled     │
│                                                                 (scored-task default) or inherit │
│                                                                 (explicit opt-in).               │
│ --sandbox-user                            TEXT                  Sandbox user (null for root)     │
│                                                                 [default: agent]                 │
│ --sandbox-setup-timeout                   INTEGER               Timeout (seconds) for sandbox    │
│                                                                 user setup inside the            │
│                                                                 environment (default: 120; keeps │
│                                                                 the file's value with --config). │
│ --context-root                            PATH                  Repo/build-context root used to  │
│                                                                 stage Dockerfile COPY sources    │
│                                                                 for monorepo-authored local      │
│                                                                 tasks.                           │
│ --base-image-override                     TEXT                  Rewrite task Dockerfile FROM     │
│                                                                 images on the runtime task copy. │
│                                                                 Use only for reproducing runs    │
│                                                                 whose base image moved           │
│                                                                 namespaces.                      │
│ --separate-verifier                                             Run each verifier in a fresh     │
│                                                                 sandbox built from the verifier  │
│                                                                 image that receives only the     │
│                                                                 frozen workspace, declared       │
│                                                                 artifacts and /logs/artifacts,   │
│                                                                 as if every task set             │
│                                                                 [verifier].sandbox_mode =        │
│                                                                 'separate'. Docker,              │
│                                                                 remote-docker, Daytona and       │
│                                                                 Modal.                           │
│ --separate-verifier-include               TEXT                  A path outside the workspace     │
│                                                                 that a separate verifier sandbox │
│                                                                 receives too, at the same path,  │
│                                                                 for tasks whose agent writes     │
│                                                                 graded files there (e.g. /root   │
│                                                                 when the workspace is /app).     │
│                                                                 Repeatable.                      │
│ --skills-dir                              PATH                  Skills directory to deploy       │
│ --skill-mode                              TEXT                  Skill mode: no-skill,            │
│                                                                 with-skill, or self-gen          │
│                                                                 [default: no-skill]              │
│ --skill-creator-dir                       PATH                  Path to skill-creator or a       │
│                                                                 skills root containing it        │
│ --self-gen-no-internet                                          Disable web tools for the        │
│                                                                 self-generated run               │
│ --loop-strategy                           TEXT                  Harness loop strategy, e.g.      │
│                                                                 'verify-retry:k=3,feedback=name… │
│                                                                 'self-review:k=3', or            │
│                                                                 'single-shot' (default).         │
│                                                                 verify-retry re-prompts with     │
│                                                                 filtered soft-verifier feedback; │
│                                                                 self-review re-prompts the agent │
│                                                                 to critique its OWN work (no     │
│                                                                 verifier signal) — both loop     │
│                                                                 until the soft verifier passes   │
│                                                                 or k retries are spent.          │
│ --reviewer-agent                          TEXT                  Rubric reviewer harness          │
│ --reviewer-model                          TEXT                  Rubric reviewer model            │
│ --reviewer-reasoning-effort               TEXT                  Rubric reviewer reasoning effort │
│ --reviewer-sandbox                        TEXT                  Rubric reviewer sandbox backend  │
│ --reviewer-timeout-sec                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer execution budget in     │
│                                                                 seconds                          │
│ --reviewer-idle-timeout                   TEXT                  Abort a reviewer prompt after    │
│                                                                 this many idle seconds (default: │
│                                                                 600). Pass 0 or 'none' to        │
│                                                                 disable the idle watchdog and    │
│                                                                 leave --reviewer-timeout-sec in  │
│                                                                 charge.                          │
│ --reviewer-storage-mb                     INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox disk in MB      │
│                                                                 (default: the evidence it holds  │
│                                                                 plus 2048, at least 4096, at     │
│                                                                 most the sandbox backend's       │
│                                                                 limit)                           │
│ --reviewer-memory-mb                      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox memory in MB    │
│                                                                 (default: 2048)                  │
│ --reviewer-setup-timeout                  INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds for the reviewer         │
│                                                                 sandbox's setup, its model proxy │
│                                                                 install among it (default: the   │
│                                                                 run's --sandbox-setup-timeout)   │
│ --reviewer-evidence-timeout               INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds to unpack, and again to  │
│                                                                 check, the workspace evidence in │
│                                                                 the reviewer sandbox (default: 1 │
│                                                                 per MiB, at least 600)           │
│ --reviewer-concurrency                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Max concurrent rubric reviewers  │
│ --reviewer-image                          TEXT                  Rubric reviewer container image  │
│ --reviewer-agent-env                      TEXT                  Reviewer environment variable    │
│                                                                 (KEY=VALUE)                      │
│ --reviewer-open-network                                         Allow unrestricted reviewer      │
│                                                                 network access                   │
│ --agent-env                               TEXT                  Agent env var (KEY=VALUE)        │
│ --allow-task-env                          TEXT                  Let tasks read this variable of  │
│                                                                 your environment (a ${NAME} env  │
│                                                                 value, or their                  │
│                                                                 docker-compose.yaml);            │
│                                                                 repeatable. A task reading an    │
│                                                                 unnamed one is refused;          │
│                                                                 ${NAME:-default} gets the        │
│                                                                 default                          │
│ --include                         -i      TEXT                  Only run these task names;       │
│                                                                 repeatable (e.g. --include       │
│                                                                 jax-computing-basics --include   │
│                                                                 data-to-d3)                      │
│ --exclude                         -x      TEXT                  Skip these task names;           │
│                                                                 repeatable (e.g. --exclude       │
│                                                                 quantum-numerical-simulation)    │
│ --dataset                         -d      TEXT                  Registry dataset to run, as      │
│                                                                 <name>@<version> (e.g.           │
│                                                                 skillsbench@1.1). Resolves the   │
│                                                                 pinned snapshot and verifies     │
│                                                                 task content digests.            │
│ --registry                                TEXT                  Dataset registry JSON URL or     │
│                                                                 local file, or a BenchFlow Hub   │
│                                                                 as hub:<url> (default:           │
│                                                                 BenchFlow's registry, then       │
│                                                                 $BENCHFLOW_HUB_URL). Only valid  │
│                                                                 with --dataset.                  │
│ --ignore-bench-version                                          Run a dataset even when this     │
│                                                                 bench version is outside the     │
│                                                                 range it was validated against.  │
│                                                                 Only valid with --dataset.       │
│ --task-manifest-out                       PATH                  Write selected task-set manifest │
│                                                                 JSON                             │
│ --run-config-out                          PATH                  Write redacted normalized run    │
│                                                                 config JSON                      │
│ --health-summary-out                      PATH                  Write trajectory health summary  │
│                                                                 JSON                             │
│ --expected-tasks                          INTEGER               Fail unless the selected task    │
│                                                                 count matches                    │
│ --canonicalize                            TEXT                  Canonicalization policy: none or │
│                                                                 one-healthy-per-task             │
│                                                                 [default: none]                  │
│ --canonical-selection-out                 PATH                  Write canonical                  │
│                                                                 rollout-selection JSON           │
│ --canonical-jobs-dir                      PATH                  Materialize selected rollout     │
│                                                                 dirs for trainer conversion      │
│ --retry-policy                            TEXT                  Retry policy: default or         │
│                                                                 unscored-only                    │
│                                                                 [default: default]               │
│ --retry-attempts                          INTEGER               Retries per task after a         │
│                                                                 retryable failure (overrides the │
│                                                                 default of 2)                    │
│ --retry-concurrency                       INTEGER               Reserved retry concurrency       │
│ --publish-hf                              TEXT                  Upload final eval artifacts to a │
│                                                                 HF dataset repo                  │
│ --hf-prefix                               TEXT                  Path prefix in the HF repo       │
│ --hf-public-read-check                                          Verify public HF reads after     │
│                                                                 upload                           │
│ --publish-bucket                          TEXT                  Upload final eval artifacts to a │
│                                                                 HF bucket                        │
│ --eval-results-model                      TEXT                  HF model repo to open a          │
│                                                                 community eval-results PR on     │
│ --eval-results-dataset                    TEXT                  HF benchmark dataset id, e.g.    │
│                                                                 org/benchmark                    │
│ --eval-results-task                       TEXT                  Benchmark task_id from the       │
│                                                                 dataset's eval.yaml              │
│ --matrix                                  PATH                  YAML file whose models: maps     │
│                                                                 each alias to a model, or to     │
│                                                                 {model, agent, agent_env};       │
│                                                                 {agent: oracle} for a control    │
│                                                                 (docs/audit/compare-runs.md#cho… │
│ --trials                                  INTEGER               Run every task N times (pass@k); │
│                                                                 each repeat is a job of its own, │
│                                                                 in <jobs dir>/<agent>/trial-NN   │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --n-tasks,--limit                 -n      INTEGER               Run at most N tasks after        │
│                                                                 --include/--exclude: the first   │
│                                                                 N, or a seeded random sample     │
│                                                                 with --sample-seed               │
│ --sample-seed                             INTEGER               Seed for the --n-tasks random    │
│                                                                 sample                           │
│ --timeout-multiplier                      FLOAT                 Scale every task's agent time    │
│                                                                 budget (task.md                  │
│                                                                 agent.timeout_sec), e.g. 2.0     │
│ --extra-instruction                       TEXT                  Text appended to every task      │
│                                                                 prompt (prompt ablations;        │
│                                                                 recorded per rollout)            │
│ --dry-run                                                       Resolve the plan (agent, model,  │
│                                                                 selected tasks, seeds, budgets)  │
│                                                                 and print it without running;    │
│                                                                 exits 1 when the run card would  │
│                                                                 refuse the run                   │
│ --seeds                                   TEXT                  Seeded rollouts: run every task  │
│                                                                 once per seed, e.g. 0-4 or 0,3,7 │
│                                                                 (tasks in a task format that     │
│                                                                 writes seeded variants, such as  │
│                                                                 embodied tasks). summary.json    │
│                                                                 gets pass@k and variance per     │
│                                                                 task.                            │
│ --help                                                          Show this message and exit.      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval create --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval create [OPTIONS]                                                                 
                                                                                                    
 Run an evaluation — single task or batch.                                                          
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --config,--run-config                     PATH                  YAML run-config file (the whole  │
│                                                                 run spec)                        │
│ --tasks-dir                               PATH                  Local tasks directory            │
│ --source-repo                             TEXT                  GitHub repo of the tasks as      │
│                                                                 org/repo (e.g.                   │
│                                                                 benchflow-ai/skillsbench)        │
│ --source-path                             TEXT                  Folder in the repo: one task     │
│                                                                 (tasks/econ-detrending-correlat… │
│                                                                 or a folder of tasks (tasks).    │
│                                                                 Only this folder is downloaded   │
│ --source-ref                              TEXT                  Branch, tag or full commit SHA   │
│                                                                 to fetch (e.g. main)             │
│ --source-env                              TEXT                  Hosted environment source (e.g.  │
│                                                                 primeintellect/general-agent)    │
│ --source-env-version                      TEXT                  Hosted environment version       │
│ --source-env-arg                          TEXT                  Hosted environment arg as        │
│                                                                 KEY=VALUE; repeatable            │
│ --source-env-num-examples                 INTEGER               Number of env examples           │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --source-env-rollouts-per-examp…          INTEGER               Rollouts per hosted env example  │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --source-env-max-tokens                   INTEGER               Max tokens for hosted env run    │
│                                                                 [default: 1024]                  │
│ --source-env-temperature                  FLOAT                 Temperature for hosted env run   │
│                                                                 (default: none sent, so the      │
│                                                                 provider's own)                  │
│ --source-env-sampling-arg                 TEXT                  Hosted env sampling arg as       │
│                                                                 KEY=VALUE; repeatable (e.g.      │
│                                                                 reasoning_effort=minimal)        │
│ --source-env-verifiers-version            TEXT                  Pin the verifiers release        │
│                                                                 installed with the hosted env    │
│                                                                 (default: the env package's own  │
│                                                                 requirement)                     │
│ --source-env-base-url                     TEXT                  Model endpoint for the hosted    │
│                                                                 env run (default: verifiers'     │
│                                                                 own, Prime inference with        │
│                                                                 PRIME_API_KEY)                   │
│ --source-env-api-key-var                  TEXT                  Name of the environment variable │
│                                                                 holding that endpoint's API key  │
│ --agent                           -a      TEXT                  Agent: claude, codex, gemini,    │
│                                                                 ... (bench agents), oracle (the  │
│                                                                 task's reference solution) or    │
│                                                                 nop (does nothing)               │
│ --model                           -m      TEXT                  Model id for the agent, e.g.     │
│                                                                 claude-haiku-5-5 (none for       │
│                                                                 oracle and nop)                  │
│ --reasoning-effort                        TEXT                  Agent reasoning/thinking effort  │
│                                                                 when the agent exposes one (e.g. │
│                                                                 max)                             │
│ --harness                                 TEXT                  How the agent runs: acp          │
│                                                                 (default, its ACP adapter) or    │
│                                                                 native (its own CLI in headless  │
│                                                                 JSON mode; claude-agent-acp and  │
│                                                                 codex-acp)                       │
│ --sandbox                         -s      TEXT                  Sandbox: docker, remote-docker,  │
│                                                                 daytona, modal, apple-container, │
│                                                                 or agentcore                     │
│ --usage-tracking                          TEXT                  Telemetry-enforcement policy:    │
│                                                                 auto, required, or off. The      │
│                                                                 LiteLLM proxy is always used for │
│                                                                 routable agents (usage, cost,    │
│                                                                 and llm_trajectory.jsonl are     │
│                                                                 always captured); this flag only │
│                                                                 controls whether trusted         │
│                                                                 telemetry is required.           │
│ --environment-manifest                    PATH                  Environment-plane manifest       │
│                                                                 applied to every rollout: a path │
│                                                                 to an environment.toml, OR a     │
│                                                                 'name@version' registry spec     │
│                                                                 resolved via                     │
│                                                                 $BENCHFLOW_ENV_REGISTRY when     │
│                                                                 set, else the built-in registry  │
│                                                                 shipped with benchflow           │
│                                                                 (env0@prod, env0@outage). The    │
│                                                                 manifest-declared stateful       │
│                                                                 environment is provisioned,      │
│                                                                 gated on readiness, and torn     │
│                                                                 down.                            │
│ --state                                   TEXT                  The stateful environment to      │
│                                                                 bind, apart from the task.       │
│                                                                 Inline JSON with an optional     │
│                                                                 tool subset (e.g. {"name":       │
│                                                                 "env0", "tools": ["gmail",       │
│                                                                 "gcal"]}), OR a name@version     │
│                                                                 spec, OR a manifest path. Takes  │
│                                                                 precedence over                  │
│                                                                 --environment-manifest.          │
│ --prompt                                  TEXT                  Prompt(s) to send (default: the  │
│                                                                 task prompt: the task.md body,   │
│                                                                 or instruction.md for older      │
│                                                                 tasks)                           │
│ --config-override                         TEXT                  Deep-merge a config patch into   │
│                                                                 each task's resolved config for  │
│                                                                 this run. Inline JSON/YAML/TOML  │
│                                                                 or an @file ref, e.g.            │
│                                                                 --config-override                │
│                                                                 '{"agent":{"timeout_sec":120}}'. │
│                                                                 Varies one knob (budget, skills, │
│                                                                 stopping rules) while the tasks, │
│                                                                 agent, model and environment     │
│                                                                 stay fixed; recorded by content  │
│                                                                 hash for replay.                 │
│ --concurrency                     -j      INTEGER               Trials running at a time. On     │
│                                                                 Docker a job also prepares up to │
│                                                                 --warm-pool sandboxes ahead      │
│                                                                 (default 1 when this is 2 or     │
│                                                                 more)                            │
│ --build-concurrency                       INTEGER               Max concurrent docker image      │
│                                                                 builds. Defaults to              │
│                                                                 --concurrency. Set lower (e.g.   │
│                                                                 8) when --concurrency is high to │
│                                                                 avoid overwhelming the docker    │
│                                                                 daemon with parallel builds.     │
│ --warm-pool                               INTEGER               Docker: how many sandboxes to    │
│                                                                 prepare ahead of their trial's   │
│                                                                 turn, beyond the --concurrency   │
│                                                                 running ones (0 to               │
│                                                                 --concurrency; default 1, or 0   │
│                                                                 when --concurrency is 1)         │
│ --worker-concurrency                      INTEGER               Run batch eval through isolated  │
│                                                                 worker subprocesses, each with   │
│                                                                 at most this many concurrent     │
│                                                                 tasks; --concurrency remains the │
│                                                                 aggregate target.                │
│ --worker-retries                          INTEGER               Retry a crashed worker shard     │
│                                                                 this many times, resuming its    │
│                                                                 jobs_dir.                        │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --worker-start-stagger-sec                FLOAT                 Seconds to stagger worker starts │
│                                                                 to avoid Daytona connection      │
│                                                                 storms.                          │
│                                                                 [default: 1.0]                   │
│ --agent-idle-timeout,--idle-tim…          TEXT                  Abort a prompt when the agent is │
│                                                                 silent this long: seconds, or    │
│                                                                 90s, 10m, 1h; 0, none or null    │
│                                                                 turns it off and leaves the      │
│                                                                 task's wall-clock timeout        │
│                                                                 (default: 10m, 30m at effort     │
│                                                                 xhigh or max)                    │
│ --checkpoints                             TEXT                  Keep a sandbox snapshot after    │
│                                                                 these prompts: every-prompt or   │
│                                                                 prompt:N[,M]. Later `bench       │
│                                                                 branch --from-checkpoint         │
│                                                                 <trial>` forks from one. Docker, │
│                                                                 or Daytona direct; each is a     │
│                                                                 full filesystem image. See       │
│                                                                 docs/train/environment.md        │
│ --checkpoint-keep                         INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Keep at most this many           │
│                                                                 checkpoints per trial (default   │
│                                                                 3, or a run config's             │
│                                                                 checkpoint_keep); the oldest is  │
│                                                                 deleted.                         │
│ --freeze-workspace                                              Save each trial's final          │
│                                                                 workspace and declared artifacts │
│                                                                 (evidence/, with a manifest)     │
│                                                                 before the verifier runs, so     │
│                                                                 `bench regrade` can re-score it  │
│                                                                 with a changed verifier.         │
│ --keep-sandbox                            TEXT                  Keep a trial's sandbox:          │
│                                                                 on-failure, always or never      │
│                                                                 (default). `bench sandbox attach │
│                                                                 <trial>` opens a shell in it;    │
│                                                                 `bench sandbox release <trial>`  │
│                                                                 deletes it.                      │
│ --accept-deviations                       TEXT                  Why this run differs from its    │
│                                                                 task set's run-reference.toml (a │
│                                                                 strict one refuses the run       │
│                                                                 without it); kept in             │
│                                                                 run-card.json.                   │
│ --fresh-install                                                 Install the model proxy and the  │
│                                                                 agent in every trial instead of  │
│                                                                 starting from their cached image │
│                                                                 layers (same as                  │
│                                                                 BENCHFLOW_FRESH_INSTALL=1)       │
│ --allow-cloud-metadata                                          Let the agent reach the cloud    │
│                                                                 metadata endpoints under an open │
│                                                                 network (no block; each trial    │
│                                                                 records the opt-out). Without    │
│                                                                 it, or the task's                │
│                                                                 allow_cloud_metadata = true, the │
│                                                                 agent starts only once the block │
│                                                                 is proven on                     │
│ --integrity                               TEXT                  off, audit (record what the      │
│                                                                 agent did and check it against   │
│                                                                 the task) or strict (audit, and  │
│                                                                 the verifier in a separate       │
│                                                                 sandbox). The verdict is in      │
│                                                                 integrity/claim_verdict.json;    │
│                                                                 rewards never change.            │
│ --verifier-sandbox                        TEXT                  task (default: each task's own   │
│                                                                 choice) or separate: every       │
│                                                                 verifier in a fresh sandbox with │
│                                                                 only the workspace and the       │
│                                                                 declared artifacts; a task that  │
│                                                                 cannot run there refuses the     │
│                                                                 run.                             │
│ --retry-from-checkpoint                   TEXT                  on-failure, on-timeout, or both: │
│                                                                 when a trial fails or times out, │
│                                                                 fork one retry from its last     │
│                                                                 --checkpoints snapshot, verified │
│                                                                 the same way. The trial's reward │
│                                                                 is kept; the retry's is reported │
│                                                                 next to it (result.json retry    │
│                                                                 block, summary                   │
│                                                                 checkpoint_retries).             │
│ --retry-prompt                            TEXT                  Prompt for the retry, replacing  │
│                                                                 the prompts after the checkpoint │
│                                                                 (the default). '@instruction' is │
│                                                                 the task instruction,            │
│                                                                 '@verifier_feedback' the failed  │
│                                                                 trial's reward and verifier      │
│                                                                 output tail.                     │
│ --max-cost-usd                            FLOAT                 Job budget in USD, checked       │
│                                                                 between starts, so a job can     │
│                                                                 pass it by about one rollout's   │
│                                                                 cost; at the cap running         │
│                                                                 rollouts are cancelled. With     │
│                                                                 --trials, each repeat has its    │
│                                                                 own cap                          │
│ --max-sandbox-seconds                     FLOAT                 Job budget in trial wall-clock   │
│                                                                 seconds, running trials included │
│                                                                 and re-checked as they run; same │
│                                                                 stop/cancel behaviour as         │
│                                                                 --max-cost-usd                   │
│ --max-tokens                              INTEGER               Job budget in tokens, checked    │
│                                                                 between starts like              │
│                                                                 --max-cost-usd. With --trials,   │
│                                                                 each repeat has its own cap      │
│ --max-rollouts                            INTEGER               Job budget in rollouts started,  │
│                                                                 retries included: at the cap no  │
│                                                                 rollout starts and running ones  │
│                                                                 finish                           │
│ --token-budget                            INTEGER               Per-trial budget in tokens       │
│                                                                 (input, cached included, plus    │
│                                                                 output), subagents' calls        │
│                                                                 included: BenchFlow's model      │
│                                                                 proxy refuses the next model     │
│                                                                 call once it is spent, the agent │
│                                                                 is stopped and its work graded.  │
│                                                                 Replaces a task's  token_budget  │
│ --turn-budget                             INTEGER               Per-trial budget in turns, one   │
│                                                                 turn being one model call        │
│                                                                 through BenchFlow's model proxy  │
│                                                                 (subagents' and side calls       │
│                                                                 included); enforced like         │
│                                                                 --token-budget. Replaces a       │
│                                                                 task's  turn_budget              │
│ --retry-resume-session                                          The retry resumes the failed     │
│                                                                 trial's conversation at the      │
│                                                                 checkpoint (ACP session/load;    │
│                                                                 Claude Code) instead of a fresh  │
│                                                                 session.                         │
│ --quiet                                                         Print only warnings, errors and  │
│                                                                 the final score: no Rich         │
│                                                                 dashboard on a TTY, no progress  │
│                                                                 heartbeat (the '… Nmin, K tool   │
│                                                                 calls' lines) and no per-trial   │
│                                                                 log lines                        │
│ --jobs-dir                                TEXT                  Output directory (default jobs); │
│                                                                 a plain run resumes its latest   │
│                                                                 job                              │
│ --fresh                                                         Start a new timestamped job      │
│                                                                 instead of resuming the latest   │
│                                                                 job in --jobs-dir (the default   │
│                                                                 reuses its finished tasks)       │
│ --job-name                                TEXT                  Job folder name under --jobs-dir │
│                                                                 (resumed if it exists)           │
│ --restart-changed                                               When the named job ran with      │
│                                                                 other settings or task files,    │
│                                                                 set those trials aside and run   │
│                                                                 them again (default: refuse)     │
│ --fail-under                              FLOAT                 Exit 1 when the pass rate        │
│                                                                 (passed / planned tasks; one a   │
│                                                                 budget kept from running counts  │
│                                                                 as not passed) is below this,    │
│                                                                 e.g. 0.8                         │
│ --fail-on                                 TEXT                  Exit 1 when any trial ended this │
│                                                                 way: timeout, error,             │
│                                                                 verifier-error (comma-separated  │
│                                                                 or repeated)                     │
│ --summary-out                             PATH                  Write the run's                  │
│                                                                 benchflow.run-summary JSON (job  │
│                                                                 dir, counts, gate) here          │
│ --codex-apps-policy                       TEXT                  Codex account Apps: disabled     │
│                                                                 (scored-task default) or inherit │
│                                                                 (explicit opt-in).               │
│ --sandbox-user                            TEXT                  Sandbox user (null for root)     │
│                                                                 [default: agent]                 │
│ --sandbox-setup-timeout                   INTEGER               Timeout (seconds) for sandbox    │
│                                                                 user setup inside the            │
│                                                                 environment (default: 120; keeps │
│                                                                 the file's value with --config). │
│ --context-root                            PATH                  Repo/build-context root used to  │
│                                                                 stage Dockerfile COPY sources    │
│                                                                 for monorepo-authored local      │
│                                                                 tasks.                           │
│ --base-image-override                     TEXT                  Rewrite task Dockerfile FROM     │
│                                                                 images on the runtime task copy. │
│                                                                 Use only for reproducing runs    │
│                                                                 whose base image moved           │
│                                                                 namespaces.                      │
│ --separate-verifier                                             Run each verifier in a fresh     │
│                                                                 sandbox built from the verifier  │
│                                                                 image that receives only the     │
│                                                                 frozen workspace, declared       │
│                                                                 artifacts and /logs/artifacts,   │
│                                                                 as if every task set             │
│                                                                 [verifier].sandbox_mode =        │
│                                                                 'separate'. Docker,              │
│                                                                 remote-docker, Daytona and       │
│                                                                 Modal.                           │
│ --separate-verifier-include               TEXT                  A path outside the workspace     │
│                                                                 that a separate verifier sandbox │
│                                                                 receives too, at the same path,  │
│                                                                 for tasks whose agent writes     │
│                                                                 graded files there (e.g. /root   │
│                                                                 when the workspace is /app).     │
│                                                                 Repeatable.                      │
│ --skills-dir                              PATH                  Skills directory to deploy       │
│ --skill-mode                              TEXT                  Skill mode: no-skill,            │
│                                                                 with-skill, or self-gen          │
│                                                                 [default: no-skill]              │
│ --skill-creator-dir                       PATH                  Path to skill-creator or a       │
│                                                                 skills root containing it        │
│ --self-gen-no-internet                                          Disable web tools for the        │
│                                                                 self-generated run               │
│ --loop-strategy                           TEXT                  Harness loop strategy, e.g.      │
│                                                                 'verify-retry:k=3,feedback=name… │
│                                                                 'self-review:k=3', or            │
│                                                                 'single-shot' (default).         │
│                                                                 verify-retry re-prompts with     │
│                                                                 filtered soft-verifier feedback; │
│                                                                 self-review re-prompts the agent │
│                                                                 to critique its OWN work (no     │
│                                                                 verifier signal) — both loop     │
│                                                                 until the soft verifier passes   │
│                                                                 or k retries are spent.          │
│ --reviewer-agent                          TEXT                  Rubric reviewer harness          │
│ --reviewer-model                          TEXT                  Rubric reviewer model            │
│ --reviewer-reasoning-effort               TEXT                  Rubric reviewer reasoning effort │
│ --reviewer-sandbox                        TEXT                  Rubric reviewer sandbox backend  │
│ --reviewer-timeout-sec                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer execution budget in     │
│                                                                 seconds                          │
│ --reviewer-idle-timeout                   TEXT                  Abort a reviewer prompt after    │
│                                                                 this many idle seconds (default: │
│                                                                 600). Pass 0 or 'none' to        │
│                                                                 disable the idle watchdog and    │
│                                                                 leave --reviewer-timeout-sec in  │
│                                                                 charge.                          │
│ --reviewer-storage-mb                     INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox disk in MB      │
│                                                                 (default: the evidence it holds  │
│                                                                 plus 2048, at least 4096, at     │
│                                                                 most the sandbox backend's       │
│                                                                 limit)                           │
│ --reviewer-memory-mb                      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox memory in MB    │
│                                                                 (default: 2048)                  │
│ --reviewer-setup-timeout                  INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds for the reviewer         │
│                                                                 sandbox's setup, its model proxy │
│                                                                 install among it (default: the   │
│                                                                 run's --sandbox-setup-timeout)   │
│ --reviewer-evidence-timeout               INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds to unpack, and again to  │
│                                                                 check, the workspace evidence in │
│                                                                 the reviewer sandbox (default: 1 │
│                                                                 per MiB, at least 600)           │
│ --reviewer-concurrency                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Max concurrent rubric reviewers  │
│ --reviewer-image                          TEXT                  Rubric reviewer container image  │
│ --reviewer-agent-env                      TEXT                  Reviewer environment variable    │
│                                                                 (KEY=VALUE)                      │
│ --reviewer-open-network                                         Allow unrestricted reviewer      │
│                                                                 network access                   │
│ --agent-env                               TEXT                  Agent env var (KEY=VALUE)        │
│ --allow-task-env                          TEXT                  Let tasks read this variable of  │
│                                                                 your environment (a ${NAME} env  │
│                                                                 value, or their                  │
│                                                                 docker-compose.yaml);            │
│                                                                 repeatable. A task reading an    │
│                                                                 unnamed one is refused;          │
│                                                                 ${NAME:-default} gets the        │
│                                                                 default                          │
│ --include                         -i      TEXT                  Only run these task names;       │
│                                                                 repeatable (e.g. --include       │
│                                                                 jax-computing-basics --include   │
│                                                                 data-to-d3)                      │
│ --exclude                         -x      TEXT                  Skip these task names;           │
│                                                                 repeatable (e.g. --exclude       │
│                                                                 quantum-numerical-simulation)    │
│ --dataset                         -d      TEXT                  Registry dataset to run, as      │
│                                                                 <name>@<version> (e.g.           │
│                                                                 skillsbench@1.1). Resolves the   │
│                                                                 pinned snapshot and verifies     │
│                                                                 task content digests.            │
│ --registry                                TEXT                  Dataset registry JSON URL or     │
│                                                                 local file, or a BenchFlow Hub   │
│                                                                 as hub:<url> (default:           │
│                                                                 BenchFlow's registry, then       │
│                                                                 $BENCHFLOW_HUB_URL). Only valid  │
│                                                                 with --dataset.                  │
│ --ignore-bench-version                                          Run a dataset even when this     │
│                                                                 bench version is outside the     │
│                                                                 range it was validated against.  │
│                                                                 Only valid with --dataset.       │
│ --task-manifest-out                       PATH                  Write selected task-set manifest │

│ --run-config-out                          PATH                  Write redacted normalized run    │

│                                                                 JSON                             │
│ --expected-tasks                          INTEGER               Fail unless the selected task    │
│                                                                 count matches                    │
│ --canonicalize                            TEXT                  Canonicalization policy: none or │
│                                                                 one-healthy-per-task             │
│                                                                 [default: none]                  │
│ --canonical-selection-out                 PATH                  Write canonical                  │
│                                                                 rollout-selection JSON           │
│ --canonical-jobs-dir                      PATH                  Materialize selected rollout     │
│                                                                 dirs for trainer conversion      │
│ --retry-policy                            TEXT                  Retry policy: default or         │
│                                                                 unscored-only                    │
│                                                                 [default: default]               │
│ --retry-attempts                          INTEGER               Retries per task after a         │
│                                                                 retryable failure (overrides the │
│                                                                 default of 2)                    │
│ --retry-concurrency                       INTEGER               Reserved retry concurrency       │
