│ --hf-prefix                               TEXT                  Path prefix in the HF repo       │
│ --hf-public-read-check                                          Verify public HF reads after     │
│                                                                 upload                           │
│ --publish-bucket                          TEXT                  Upload final eval artifacts to a │
│                                                                 HF bucket                        │
│ --eval-results-model                      TEXT                  HF model repo to open a          │
│                                                                 community eval-results PR on     │
│ --eval-results-dataset                    TEXT                  HF benchmark dataset id, e.g.    │
│                                                                 org/benchmark                    │
│ --eval-results-task                       TEXT                  Benchmark task_id from the       │
│                                                                 dataset's eval.yaml              │
│ --matrix                                  PATH                  YAML file whose models: maps     │
│                                                                 each alias to a model, or to     │
│                                                                 {model, agent, agent_env};       │
│                                                                 {agent: oracle} for a control    │
│                                                                 (docs/audit/compare-runs.md#cho… │
│ --trials                                  INTEGER               Run every task N times (pass@k); │
│                                                                 each repeat is a job of its own, │
│                                                                 in <jobs dir>/<agent>/trial-NN   │
│                                                                 [default: 1]                     │
│ --n-tasks,--limit                 -n      INTEGER               Run at most N tasks after        │
│                                                                 --include/--exclude: the first   │
│                                                                 N, or a seeded random sample     │
│                                                                 with --sample-seed               │
│ --sample-seed                             INTEGER               Seed for the --n-tasks random    │
│                                                                 sample                           │
│ --timeout-multiplier                      FLOAT                 Scale every task's agent time    │
│                                                                 budget (task.md                  │
│                                                                 agent.timeout_sec), e.g. 2.0     │
│ --extra-instruction                       TEXT                  Text appended to every task      │
│                                                                 prompt (prompt ablations;        │
│                                                                 recorded per rollout)            │
│ --dry-run                                                       Resolve the plan (agent, model,  │
│                                                                 selected tasks, seeds, budgets)  │
│                                                                 and print it without running;    │
│                                                                 exits 1 when the run card would  │
│                                                                 refuse the run                   │
│ --seeds                                   TEXT                  Seeded rollouts: run every task  │
│                                                                 once per seed, e.g. 0-4 or 0,3,7 │
│                                                                 (tasks in a task format that     │
│                                                                 writes seeded variants, such as  │
│                                                                 embodied tasks). summary.json    │
│                                                                 gets pass@k and variance per     │
│                                                                 task.                            │
│ --help                                                          Show this message and exit.      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval adopt --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval adopt [OPTIONS] [TARGET]                                                         
                                                                                                    
 Adopt an external benchmark into benchflow.                                                        
                                                                                                    
 Default (convert): `bench eval adopt <source>` scaffolds benchmarks/<name>/                        
 if missing, then drives the codex conversion. `--scaffold-only` only writes                        
 the package; `--verify` runs the parity gate for the named benchmark.                              
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   target      [TARGET]  In convert mode (default) the SOURCE repo/path to adopt; in --verify /   │
│                         --scaffold-only mode the benchmark SLUG.                                 │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --name                    TEXT   Benchmark slug for convert mode (default: derived from source)  │
│ --verify                         Run the parity gate for the named benchmark                     │
│ --scaffold-only                  Only scaffold the package, do not convert                       │
│ --model                   TEXT   Model for the codex driver                                      │
│ --dry-run                        Print the launch command, do not run                            │
│ --codex-bin               TEXT   Host codex binary [default: codex]                              │
│ --codex-config    -c      TEXT   Codex config override as key=value, passed to codex as `-c      │
│                                  key=value`; repeatable (e.g. -c service_tier=flex to work       │
│                                  around host ~/.codex/config.toml drift)                         │
│ --benchmarks-dir          PATH   Target benchmarks/ directory                                    │
│ --tolerance               FLOAT  Max abs reward delta (statistical) [default: 0.02]              │
│ --issue-out               PATH   Write the divergence issue draft here                           │
│ --roundtrip-task          PATH   Also run the structural round-trip check on this task dir       │
│ --rerun                          Independently re-execute parity_test.py --mode side-by-side and │
│                                  score its fresh output, instead of the recorded                 │
│                                  parity_experiment.json                                          │
│ --help                           Show this message and exit.                                     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval compare-lift --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval compare-lift [OPTIONS]                                                           
                                                                                                    
 Compare paired baseline vs trained eval job directories.                                           
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --baseline                             DIRECTORY             Baseline BenchFlow job           │
│                                                                 directory.                       │
│                                                                 [required]                       │
│ *  --trained                              DIRECTORY             Trained BenchFlow job directory. │
│                                                                 [required]                       │
│ *  --out                                  PATH                  Markdown report output path.     │
│                                                                 [required]                       │
│ *  --json-out                             PATH                  JSON report output path.         │
│                                                                 [required]                       │
│    --bootstrap-samples                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=0]  Bootstrap samples for paired     │
│                                                                 delta confidence intervals.      │
│                                                                 [default: 1000]                  │
│    --bootstrap-seed                       INTEGER               Deterministic seed for bootstrap │
│                                                                 confidence intervals.            │
│                                                                 [default: 0]                     │
│    --allow-duplicate-first-by-path                              Allow duplicate healthy task     │
│                                                                 rollouts and keep the first by   │
│                                                                 deterministic path order.        │
│    --help                                                       Show this message and exit.      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval score --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval score [OPTIONS] PATH                                                             
                                                                                                    
 Retry a failed reviewer using the saved workspace and trajectory.                                  
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  A saved task rollout directory [required]                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --tasks-root                       PATH                  Trusted original task directory or   │
│                                                             collection                           │
│                                                             [required]                           │
│    --force                                                  Create a new revision even if        │
│                                                             scoring already completed            │
│    --reviewer-agent                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer harness              │
│    --reviewer-model                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer model                │
│    --reviewer-reasoning-effort        TEXT                  Rubric reviewer reasoning effort     │
│    --reviewer-sandbox                 TEXT                  Rubric reviewer sandbox backend      │
│    --reviewer-timeout-sec             INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer execution budget in seconds │
│    --reviewer-idle-timeout            TEXT                  Abort a reviewer prompt after this   │
│                                                             many idle seconds (default: 600).    │
│                                                             Pass 0 or 'none' to disable the idle │
│                                                             watchdog and leave                   │
│                                                             --reviewer-timeout-sec in charge.    │
│    --reviewer-storage-mb              INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox disk in MB          │
│                                                             (default: the evidence it holds plus │
│                                                             2048, at least 4096, at most the     │
│                                                             sandbox backend's limit)             │
│    --reviewer-memory-mb               INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox memory in MB        │
│                                                             (default: 2048)                      │
│    --reviewer-setup-timeout           INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds for the reviewer sandbox's   │
│                                                             setup, its model proxy install among │
│                                                             it (default: the run's               │
│                                                             --sandbox-setup-timeout)             │
│    --reviewer-evidence-timeout        INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds to unpack, and again to      │
│                                                             check, the workspace evidence in the │
│                                                             reviewer sandbox (default: 1 per     │
│                                                             MiB, at least 600)                   │
│    --reviewer-concurrency             INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Max concurrent rubric reviewers      │
│    --reviewer-image                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer container image      │
│    --reviewer-agent-env               TEXT                  Reviewer environment variable        │
│                                                             (KEY=VALUE)                          │
│    --reviewer-open-network                                  Allow unrestricted reviewer network  │
│                                                             access                               │
│    --help                                                   Show this message and exit.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval regrade --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval regrade [OPTIONS] PATH                                                           
                                                                                                    
 Re-run the task's current verifier on each trial's frozen workspace.                               
                                                                                                    
 The new score is written beside the original (regrade.json in each trial,                          
 regrade-summary.json in PATH); result.json is never changed. Trials whose                          
 workspace was not frozen (--freeze-workspace) are listed as not regradable.                        
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  A job folder, or one trial folder inside it [required]                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks-dir                        PATH                  Folder of task folders (or one task     │
│                                                          folder) holding the changed verifiers.  │
│                                                          Default: the task path each trial       │
│                                                          recorded.                               │
│ --sandbox                          TEXT                  Backend for the fresh sandboxes         │
│                                                          (default: as run)                       │
│ --concurrency                      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Trials regraded at once [default: 4]    │
│ --reason                           TEXT                  Why the verifier changed; kept in each  │
│                                                          block                                   │
│ --json                                                   Print the summary as JSON               │
│ --review                                                 Also rerun each trial's rubric review   │
│                                                          on its saved outputs, gated by the new  │
│                                                          test, and compare the combined score.   │
│                                                          The reviewer is the one the trial       │
│                                                          recorded, changed by --reviewer-*       │
│ --reviewer-agent                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer harness                 │
│ --reviewer-model                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer model                   │
│ --reviewer-reasoning-effort        TEXT                  Rubric reviewer reasoning effort        │
│ --reviewer-sandbox                 TEXT                  Rubric reviewer sandbox backend         │
│ --reviewer-timeout-sec             INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer execution budget in seconds    │
│ --reviewer-idle-timeout            TEXT                  Abort a reviewer prompt after this many │
│                                                          idle seconds (default: 600). Pass 0 or  │
│                                                          'none' to disable the idle watchdog and │
│                                                          leave --reviewer-timeout-sec in charge. │
│ --reviewer-storage-mb              INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox disk in MB (default:   │
│                                                          the evidence it holds plus 2048, at     │
│                                                          least 4096, at most the sandbox         │
│                                                          backend's limit)                        │
│ --reviewer-memory-mb               INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Reviewer sandbox memory in MB (default: │
│                                                          2048)                                   │
│ --reviewer-setup-timeout           INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds for the reviewer sandbox's      │
│                                                          setup, its model proxy install among it │
│                                                          (default: the run's                     │
│                                                          --sandbox-setup-timeout)                │
│ --reviewer-evidence-timeout        INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Seconds to unpack, and again to check,  │
│                                                          the workspace evidence in the reviewer  │
│                                                          sandbox (default: 1 per MiB, at least   │
│                                                          600)                                    │
│ --reviewer-concurrency             INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Max concurrent rubric reviewers         │
│ --reviewer-image                   TEXT                  Rubric reviewer container image         │
│ --reviewer-agent-env               TEXT                  Reviewer environment variable           │
│                                                          (KEY=VALUE)                             │
│ --reviewer-open-network                                  Allow unrestricted reviewer network     │
│                                                          access                                  │
│ --help                                                   Show this message and exit.             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench eval metrics --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval metrics [OPTIONS] JOBS_DIR                                                       
                                                                                                    
 Collect and display metrics from a jobs directory.                                                 
                                                                                                    
 One row per trial, as bf.load_job counts them: a retried task of an                                
 Evaluation job counts once, and repeated rollouts (a bf.run_batch                                  
 folder, the trial-NN folders of --matrix --trials) count as separate                               
 trials. pass@k / pass^k pool a task's trials across every job folder                               
 under the directory. Every figure counts every trial, an unscored one as                           
 a fail; with unscored trials, the scored-only figures (unscored trials                             
 left out, as BenchFlow 0.7's mean_reward was) follow with their own n. Control runs are left out   
 of the solve rates                                                                                 
 unless --include-controls, or unless the folder holds nothing else. The                            
 score follows the scoring rule benchflow.score.v1, with a 95% interval                             
 over tasks. The trials are split by what ran: agent, harness version,                              
 served model, route, effort sent, task set and BenchFlow version. A                                
 folder of several settings gets one line per setting and no pooled                                 
 score, since one number would mix them. When the pooled trials differ                              
 in agent, model or a setting bench eval compare checks, a warning names                            
 it and a table splits the trials by agent.                                                         
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    jobs_dir      PATH  Jobs directory to analyze [required]                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --benchmark               TEXT     Benchmark name                                                │
│ --agent                   TEXT     Agent name                                                    │
│ --model                   TEXT     Model name                                                    │
│ --json                             Output as JSON                                                │
│ --k                       INTEGER  k for pass@k and pass^k (repeatable; default 1, powers of two │
│                                    and multiples of five, using both trial and scored-only       │
│                                    counts)                                                       │
│ --solve-threshold         FLOAT    Count a scored trial as solved when reward >= this value      │
│                                    (partial credit); default: solved = passed (reward 1)         │
│ --include-controls                 Count control runs (oracle, empty/nop) in the solve rates and │
│                                    pass@k; a folder of only control runs counts them anyway      │
│ --help                             Show this message and exit.                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench eval continue --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval continue [OPTIONS] FOLDER                                                        
                                                                                                    
 Resume a previous unfinished (timed-out) OpenHands run to completion.                              
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    folder      PATH  Original run output folder (contains config.json +                        │
│                        trajectory/llm_trajectory.jsonl).                                         │
│                        [required]                                                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks-dir                                      PATH     Directory holding the task source      │
│                                                           (instruction + verifier). Required     │
│                                                           unless the recorded task_path still    │
│                                                           exists on disk.                        │
│ --model                                          TEXT     Override the live-continuation model   │
│                                                           (default: the original run's model).   │
│ --timeout                                        INTEGER  Wall-clock budget for the              │
│                                                           continuation, in seconds (default: the │
│                                                           original run's timeout).               │
│ --output                                         PATH     Output jobs dir for the new run        │
│                                                           (default: <orig-parent>/continued).    │
│ --require-timeout      --no-require-timeout               Refuse runs whose recorded status is   │
│                                                           not a timeout.                         │
│                                                           [default: no-require-timeout]          │
│ --strict-divergence    --no-strict-divergence             Abort if replay leaves the original    │
│                                                           rails (message-count mismatch) instead │
│                                                           of warning.                            │
│                                                           [default: no-strict-divergence]        │
│ --replay-only          --no-replay-only                   Rebuild the env via replay and stop at │
│                                                           the cut-point (no live model needed) — │
│                                                           useful for testing.                    │
│                                                           [default: no-replay-only]              │
│ --proxy-mode                                     TEXT     Replay proxy placement: auto, host, or │
│                                                           sandbox. Auto uses sandbox-local       │
│                                                           replay for Daytona/Modal and host      │
│                                                           replay for Docker.                     │
│                                                           [default: auto]                        │
│ --help                                                    Show this message and exit.            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench eval branch --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval branch [OPTIONS]                                                                 
                                                                                                    
 Fork an agent run at a checkpoint into labelled children.                                          
                                                                                                    
 Each task runs once up to the checkpoint; the sandbox (and, when asked,                            
 declared environment state) is snapshotted; every --child starts from                              
 that snapshot with a fresh agent session (child prompts must stand                                 
 alone unless --resume-session reloads the parent's conversation) and is                            
 scored by the task's verifier. The job folder has the usual layout plus, per trial, tree.json      
 and branches/<fork>/children/<node>/observation.json.                                              
                                                                                                    
 Example:                                                                                           
                                                                                                    
     bench branch --tasks-dir tasks/my-task                                                         
     --agent claude-agent-acp --sandbox daytona                                                     
     --prompt "Write draft.txt containing: Hello world"                                             
     --prompt @instruction --checkpoint-after-prompt 1                                              
     --child "label=baseline" --child "label=hint,prompt=Rename draft.txt."                         
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks-dir                        PATH                  A task directory, or a directory of     │
│                                                          tasks (run one after another).          │
│ --agent                            TEXT                  Agent name, or 'oracle' (children run   │
│                                                          the task's solve.sh). Default: the      │
│                                                          checkpoint's agent with                 │
│                                                          --from-checkpoint, else                 │
│                                                          claude-agent-acp.                       │
│ --model                    -m      TEXT                  Model id for the agent, e.g.            │
│                                                          claude-haiku-5-5 (none for oracle and   │
│                                                          nop)                                    │
│ --reasoning-effort                 TEXT                  Agent reasoning effort (e.g. max)       │
│ --harness                          TEXT                  How the agent runs: acp (default, its   │
│                                                          ACP adapter) or native (its own CLI in  │
│                                                          headless JSON mode; claude-agent-acp    │
│                                                          and codex-acp)                          │
│ --sandbox                          TEXT                  docker or daytona (Daytona direct mode  │
│                                                          snapshots). Default: docker, or the     │
│                                                          checkpoint's provider.                  │
│ --prompt                           TEXT                  Parent prompt; repeatable, sent in      │
│                                                          order. '@instruction' is the task's     │
│                                                          instruction. Default: the task's        │
│                                                          prompts.                                │
│ --checkpoint-after-prompt          INTEGER               Branch after this many parent prompts   │
│                                                          (0: before the first). Default 1; 0 for │
│                                                          the oracle and with --from-checkpoint.  │
│ --child                            TEXT                  One child, as                           │
│                                                          label=NAME[,parent=LABEL][,prompt=TEXT… │
│                                                          give at least two. prompt= takes the    │
│                                                          rest of the option (commas allowed).    │
│                                                          parent=LABEL forks this child from      │
│                                                          child LABEL's state after LABEL has run │
│                                                          its prompts (a nested fork of at least  │
│                                                          two children). Without a prompt the     │
│                                                          child runs the parent's remaining       │
│                                                          prompts, or the task's prompts when the │
│                                                          checkpoint is after the last one.       │
│ --snapshot-layers                  TEXT                  What the checkpoint captures: sandbox   │
│                                                          (container filesystem), environment     │
│                                                          (declared database state, needs a       │
│                                                          manifest), or both.                     │
│                                                          [default: sandbox]                      │
│ --parent                           TEXT                  continue: restore the parent world      │
│                                                          after the children, send the remaining  │
│                                                          prompts and verify. discard: skip that  │
│                                                          restore (one fewer), leave the parent   │
│                                                          unverified. Default: continue, or       │
│                                                          discard with --from-checkpoint.         │
│ --retain-snapshots                                       Keep the checkpoint's sandbox snapshot  │
│                                                          so a later --from-checkpoint can branch │
│                                                          from it again (otherwise deleted).      │
│                                                          `bench sandbox cleanup` removes kept    │
│                                                          Daytona snapshots once stale.           │
│ --from-checkpoint                  PATH                  A trial folder from an earlier `bench   │
│                                                          branch --retain-snapshots` run: branch  │
│                                                          again from its kept sandbox snapshot.   │
│                                                          Needs --tasks-dir holding the same      │
│                                                          task.                                   │
│ --fork,--checkpoint                TEXT                  With --from-checkpoint: a fork id from  │
│                                                          tree.json or an automatic checkpoint as │
│                                                          prompt:N (default: the last kept fork,  │
│                                                          else the last kept checkpoint).         │
│ --checkpoints                      TEXT                  Also keep a sandbox snapshot after      │
│                                                          these parent prompts (every-prompt or   │
│                                                          prompt:N[,M]) for a later               │
│                                                          --from-checkpoint.                      │
│ --checkpoint-keep                  INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Keep at most this many --checkpoints    │
│                                                          per trial.                              │
│                                                          [default: 3]                            │
│ --resume-session                                         Children resume the parent's agent      │
│                                                          conversation (ACP session/load) instead │
│                                                          of starting fresh, so a child prompt    │
│                                                          can say 'continue'. Needs an agent that │
│                                                          advertises loadSession and keeps its    │
│                                                          session on disk (Claude Code), and a    │
│                                                          checkpoint after prompt 1+.             │
│ --child-retries                    INTEGER RANGE [x>=0]  Retry a child this many times when it   │
│                                                          failed before its agent did anything (a │
│                                                          provider hiccup such as a connect       │
│                                                          timeout).                               │
│                                                          [default: 1]                            │
│ --stop-on-child-failure                                  Stop a fork at the first child that     │
│                                                          fails for good (default: the other      │
│                                                          children still run and the fork is      │
│                                                          partial).                               │
│ --concurrency                      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]  Run up to this many children of a fork  │
│                                                          at once, each in its own sandbox        │
│                                                          created from the snapshot (implies      │
│                                                          --isolate-children).                    │
│                                                          [default: 1]                            │
│ --isolate-children                                       Run each child in its own sandbox       │
│                                                          created from the snapshot instead of    │
│                                                          restoring the parent's sandbox between  │
│                                                          children. Implied by --concurrency > 1  │
│                                                          and by nested children.                 │
│ --agent-env                        TEXT                  Agent env var (KEY=VALUE); repeatable   │
│ --include                          TEXT                  Only these task names; repeatable       │
│ --jobs-dir                         PATH                  Output directory [default: jobs]        │
│ --job-name                         TEXT                  Job folder name (default:               │
│                                                          branch-<time>)                          │
│ --help                                                   Show this message and exit.             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 The same data as bf.load_job / bf.load_trial; control runs (oracle,

==> bench eval compare --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval compare [OPTIONS] JOB_A JOB_B                                                    
                                                                                                    
 Pair two jobs by task: rewards, deltas, fair denominators, setting checks.                         
                                                                                                    
 The same code as bf.compare. Each paired task is checked for comparable                            
 settings (task digest, model, harness, dataset, reasoning effort,                                  
 sandbox, sandbox user, timeout, agent variables, prompts); declare the                             
 settings the comparison is about with --vary. Reads files only.                                    
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    job_a      TEXT  Side A: a job folder, a trial, or a glob of folders [required]             │
│ *    job_b      TEXT  Side B [required]                                                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json                                    Print the benchflow.comparison JSON document           │
│ --labels                  <TEXT TEXT>...  Names for the two sides                                │
│ --vary                    TEXT            A setting the comparison is about (repeatable), e.g.   │
│                                           model                                                  │
│ --on-mismatch             TEXT            warn (default), raise (exit 1) or ignore an undeclared │
│                                           setting difference                                     │
│                                           [default: warn]                                        │
│ --include-controls                        Keep control runs (oracle, empty)                      │
│ --attempts                TEXT            best or all [default: best]                            │
│ --out                     PATH            Write the output to this file                          │
│ --by                      TEXT            Pair on these keys as well as the task, e.g.           │
│                                           agent,model                                            │
│ --k                       INTEGER         k for pass@k and pass^k (repeatable)                   │
│ --solve-threshold         FLOAT           Solved = reward >= this value (partial credit);        │
│                                           default: passed                                        │
│ --help                                    Show this message and exit.                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval resume --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval resume [OPTIONS] JOB_DIR                                                         
                                                                                                    
 Finish an interrupted job from its folder: rerun only the unfinished tasks.                        
                                                                                                    
 Reads the tasks directory and config the job recorded in evaluation.json                           
 (no agent_env value that looks secret, so pass those again with                                    
 --agent-env), then runs the tasks with no finished result. A job that is still running is          
 refused. Exit codes as for bench eval run; 2 when the folder is not a job,                         
 or when its trials ran with other settings or task files than this                                 
 resume has (an --agent-env value, an edited task): --restart-changed                               
 runs them again.                                                                                   
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    job_dir      PATH  The job folder to finish [required]                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent-env              TEXT     KEY=VALUE for the agent (repeatable); values that look secret  │
│                                   are never stored in the job                                    │
│ --concurrency            INTEGER  Override the job's concurrency                                 │
│ --restart-changed                 When the job's trials ran with other settings or task files    │
│                                   than this resume, set them aside in <job>/.set-aside/ and run  │
│                                   them again (default: refuse)                                   │
│ --help                            Show this message and exit.                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench eval branches --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench eval branches [OPTIONS] PATH                                                          
                                                                                                    
 Show every fork and child of a job's (or one trial's) branches: request, status, reward,           
 advantage, tokens, USD and sandbox-seconds.                                                        
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  A trial folder or a job folder. [required]                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json          Print the benchflow.branch-view/1 documents (a JSON list, one per branched       │
│                 trial); see docs/train/environment.md.                                           │
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench tasks --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench tasks [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                     
                                                                                                    
 Task authoring commands.                                                                           
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ generate       Generate benchmark tasks from agent traces.                                       │
│ list-sources   List known HuggingFace trace datasets.                                            │
│ init           Scaffold a new benchmark task.                                                    │
│ check          Validate task structure and the run's plan without starting a sandbox.            │
│ overlap        Compare two task manifests for exact task-id and digest overlap.                  │
│ migrate        Convert task.toml + instruction.md into the unified task.md format.               │
│ normalize      Expand minimal task.md authoring profiles into canonical task.md.                 │
│ export         Export a task to a compatibility split layout with a loss report.                 │
│ snapshot-hf    Materialize a Hugging Face dataset task tree with provenance.                     │
│ digest         Compute the content digest that pins a task's files, independent of git.          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench tasks generate --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench tasks generate [OPTIONS]                                                              
                                                                                                    
 Generate benchmark tasks from agent traces.                                                        
                                                                                                    
 Exactly one source flag (--from-local, --from-file or --from-hf) is                                
 required.                                                                                          
                                                                                                    
 Examples:                                                                                          
                                                                                                    
     bench tasks generate --from-local                                                              
     bench tasks generate --from-local --project my-repo --limit 5                                  
     bench tasks generate --from-file session.jsonl --dry-run                                       
     bench tasks generate --from-hf opentraces-test --limit 50 --outcome success                    
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --from-local                   Generate from local Claude Code sessions (~/.claude/projects/)    │
│ --from-file           PATH     Generate from a JSONL trace file (Claude Code or opentraces)      │
│ --from-hf             TEXT     Generate from a HuggingFace dataset (ID or alias; run `bench      │
│                                tasks list-sources` for aliases)                                  │
│ --output              PATH     Output directory for generated tasks [default: tasks]             │
│ --projects-dir        PATH     Claude Code projects directory (default: ~/.claude/projects/)     │
│ --project             TEXT     Filter local sessions by project path substring                   │
│ --format              TEXT     Trace format override: auto, claude-code, opentraces,             │
│                                claude-messages                                                   │
│                                [default: auto]                                                   │
│ --split               TEXT     HuggingFace dataset split [default: train]                        │
│ --max-rows            INTEGER  Max rows to download from HuggingFace [default: 100]              │
│ --limit               INTEGER  Max traces to process [default: 20]                               │
│ --min-steps           INTEGER  Minimum steps per trace [default: 2]                              │
│ --outcome             TEXT     Filter by outcome: success, failure, unknown                      │
│ --author              TEXT     Author name written into each generated task                      │
│                                [default: benchflow-traces]                                       │
│ --task-format         TEXT     Generated task package format: task-md or legacy                  │
│                                [default: task-md]                                                │
│ --dry-run                      Preview traces without generating tasks                           │
│ --help                         Show this message and exit.                                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench tasks check --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench tasks check [OPTIONS] TASK_DIR                                                        
                                                                                                    
 Validate task structure and the run's plan without starting a sandbox.                             
                                                                                                    
 Warnings (e.g. task.toml keys BenchFlow does not know) are printed                                 
 but do not fail the check.                                                                         
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    task_dir      PATH  Task directory or folder of tasks [required]                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --level                   [schema|structural|runtime-capabil  Validation level: schema,          │
│                           ity|publication-grade|acceptance|a  structural, runtime-capability,    │
│                           cceptance-live|equivalence]         publication-grade, acceptance,     │
│                                                               acceptance-live, or equivalence    │
│                                                               (runs the oracle in --sandbox,     │
│                                                               then grades wrong and              │
│                                                               value-equivalent variants of its   │
│                                                               output)                            │
│                                                               [default: structural]              │
│ --sandbox                 TEXT                                Validate runtime semantics for     │
│                                                               docker, remote-docker, daytona,    │
│                                                               modal, apple-container, or         │
│                                                               agentcore (default: a sandbox that │
│                                                               can run the task: docker, or modal │
│                                                               for a task that asks for GPUs)     │
│ --report-output           PATH                                Write the acceptance-live report   │
│                                                               to this host path instead of the   │
│                                                               task-declared report path; with    │
│                                                               --level equivalence, write the     │
│                                                               battery's JSON report here         │
│ --no-report-write                                             Validate acceptance-live without   │
│                                                               writing the declared report or its │
│                                                               .sha256 sidecar (report-only       │
│                                                               dogfood; leaves the task package   │
│                                                               unmodified). Takes precedence over │
│                                                               --report-output.                   │
│ --allow-task-env          TEXT                                Let tasks read this variable of    │
│                                                               your environment (a ${NAME} env    │
│                                                               value, or their                    │
│                                                               docker-compose.yaml); repeatable.  │
│                                                               A task reading an unnamed one is   │
│                                                               refused; ${NAME:-default} gets the │
│                                                               default                            │
│ --verifier-sandbox        TEXT                                With separate: also check what     │
│                                                               `bench run --verifier-sandbox      │
│                                                               separate` checks before it starts  │
│                                                               (on --sandbox, default docker),    │
│                                                               with the same refusals, and name   │
│                                                               where the verifier image comes     │
│                                                               from                               │
│ --agent                   TEXT                                Agent to validate, as for eval run │
│                                                               [default: claude-agent-acp]        │
│ --model                   TEXT                                Model to validate, as for eval run │
│ --sandbox-user            TEXT                                Agent user to validate, as for     │
│                                                               eval run                           │
│                                                               [default: agent]                   │
│ --help                                                        Show this message and exit.        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench review --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench review [OPTIONS] PATH                                                                 
                                                                                                    
 Grade finished rollouts against a rubric with a reviewer agent.                                    
                                                                                                    
 Reviews run detached from the rollouts they grade: each review is an                               
 ordinary sandboxed rollout of a throwaway wrapper task, evidence is a                              
 read-only copy, and results land in ``review_report.json``. The reviewed                           
 rollouts' rewards and ``result.json`` are never modified.                                          
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  A finished rollout directory, or a job directory of rollouts [required]     │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --rubric              -r      PATH     Rubric JSON file. Default: an admitted task copy's        │
│                                        verifier/rubric.json (requires --tasks-root and verified  │
│                                        digest), else the built-in default rubric.                │
│ --prompt              -p      PATH     Custom reviewer instruction template (see                 │
│                                        benchflow.review.prompts)                                 │
│ --agent               -a      TEXT     Reviewer agent harness [default: opencode]                │
│ --model               -m      TEXT     Reviewer model (default: gemini/gemini-3.5-flash-lite     │
│                                        with opencode, else the agent's registry default)         │
│ --sandbox                     TEXT     Sandbox: docker, remote-docker, daytona, modal,           │
│                                        apple-container, or agentcore                             │
│                                        [default: docker]                                         │
│ --concurrency         -n      INTEGER  Max concurrent reviews [default: 4]                       │
│ --passing                              Only review passing rollouts (reward 1.0)                 │
│ --failing                              Only review failing rollouts                              │
│ --timeout-sec                 INTEGER  Reviewer agent timeout per rollout [default: 1800]        │
│ --agent-env                   TEXT     KEY=VALUE for the reviewer (repeatable)                   │
│ --image                       TEXT     Prebuilt sandbox image for reviewer rollouts              │
│ --tasks-root                  PATH     Trusted directory holding the reviewed tasks. Required to │
│                                        include task definitions in evidence: a task path         │
│                                        recorded inside a rollout is untrusted input and is never │
│                                        read directly. Without this, reviews use run records      │
│                                        only.                                                     │
│ --allow-open-network                   Run reviewers WITHOUT the no-internet declaration.        │
│                                        Required on backends that cannot enforce network          │
│                                        isolation (e.g. agentcore) — reviews there fail closed by │
│                                        default. The report records the relaxed posture.          │
│ --out-dir             -o      PATH     Review output directory (default: jobs/review-<ts>)       │
│ --help                                 Show this message and exit.                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench assess --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench assess [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                                    
                                                                                                    
 Blind pairwise human assessments of saved outputs, kept in an opt-in sidecar.                      
                                                                                                    
 Two completed attempts of one task, a frozen rubric and judge protocol, a recorded release of      
 every runtime, the review collector's blind assignment and vote, then a deterministic label: 1 (A  
 preferred), 0 (B preferred), 0.5 (tie) or withheld (abstention). Rewards, result.json,             
 regrade.json and rollout streams are never read or changed. See docs/jobs/assessment.md.           
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ attempt-ref   Hash a completed rollout into a saved-attempt reference (JSON).                    │
│ create        Start an assessment of two saved attempts of one task.                             │
│ release       Record that every runtime of both attempts was observed released.                  │
│ assign        Bind the collector's persisted blind assignment (after the release).               │
│ import-vote   Bind the collector's vote on the assignment (a skip becomes abstain).              │
│ correct       Replace the effective answer with a corrected one.                                 │
│ retract       Retract the effective answer; its history stays in the log.                        │
│ reduce        Record the deterministic label the log calls for, and refresh the label file.      │
│ consume       Record that a consumer used one exact ready label revision.                        │
│ withdraw      Bar a corrected or retracted label revision from future use.                       │
│ show          Verify the sidecar's log and print its state.                                      │
│ verify        Verify the hash chain, the label file and, optionally, the evidence.               │
│ label         Print the label rebuilt from the sidecar's log alone (JSON).                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench assess attempt-ref --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench assess attempt-ref [OPTIONS] ROLLOUT                                                  
                                                                                                    
 Hash a completed rollout into a saved-attempt reference (JSON).                                    
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    rollout      PATH  A completed rollout folder (holds result.json). [required]               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --output                  PATH  The output to compare: a folder or one file. [required]       │
│ *  --review-artifact         PATH  The file a reviewer sees (e.g. a preview image). [required]   │
│    --sandbox-provider        TEXT  Provider of result.json's sandbox_id (daytona, docker, modal, │
│                                    ...).                                                         │
│    --sandbox-role            TEXT  solver, verifier or shared (one sandbox for both).            │
│                                    [default: solver]                                             │
│    --runtime                 TEXT  Another allocation of this attempt:                           │
│                                    PROVIDER:RUNTIME_ID[:ROLE]. Repeatable.                       │
│    --media-type              TEXT  The review artifact's media type.                             │
│    --out                     PATH  Write the reference here (a new file) instead of stdout.      │
│    --help                          Show this message and exit.                                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench assess assign --help <==

==> bench preferences --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench preferences [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...                                               
                                                                                                    
 Human preferences and rubric scores on finished trials.                                            
                                                                                                    
 `pairs` makes blind pairs of trial outputs (same task version, different agent or model) for a     
 rater's tool, `import` takes the votes and rubric scores it collected, and `rank` gives            
 Bradley-Terry ratings on the Elo scale with rater checks. Votes are never rewards: no trial file   
 is changed. See docs/tasks/human-preferences.md.                                                   
                                                                                                    
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ pairs    Make the store and the blind assignment.                                                │
│ import   Check every vote in the file, then add the new ones to the store.                       │
│ rank     Ratings from the store's votes (also written to ratings.v1.json).                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench preferences pairs --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench preferences pairs [OPTIONS] [JOBS]...                                                 
                                                                                                    
 Make the store and the blind assignment.                                                           
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   jobs      [JOBS]...  Job or trial folders whose outputs to pair (none with only --items).      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --store             PATH     A new folder for the preference store. [required]                │
│ *  --out               PATH     The file to write the blind pairs to, for the raters' tool.      │
│                                 [required]                                                       │
│    --output            TEXT     Which folder of each trial the raters compare, relative to the   │
│                                 trial (artifacts, or evidence/workspace with                     │
│                                 --freeze-workspace).                                             │
│                                 [default: artifacts]                                             │
│    --per-task          INTEGER  At most this many pairs per task.                                │
│    --seed              INTEGER  Seed for sampling and sides (default: random, recorded).         │
│    --rubric            PATH     A rubric JSON file to freeze for aspects and scores.             │
│    --bundle            PATH     Where to copy the outputs under their opaque ids for the rating  │
│                                 tool (default: <store>-outputs beside the store).                │
│    --keep-sides                 Do not shuffle which output is shown on the left.                │
│    --items             PATH     A JSON-lines file of outputs made outside BenchFlow (a golden, a │
│                                 remix), each with its task, output folder and arm labels; they   │
│                                 pair with the trials of their task's version.                    │
│    --condition         TEXT     A condition to label every trial's output with (one-shot, say);  │
│                                 --items rows carry their own.                                    │
│    --entry             TEXT     The page to open in each output, such as index.html; an output   │
│                                 without it is left out.                                          │
│    --golden            TEXT     Whether a golden from --items is a side in pairs (side) or only  │
│                                 the bar a rater's tool shows (bar).                              │
│                                 [default: side]                                                  │
│    --help                       Show this message and exit.                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench preferences import --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench preferences import [OPTIONS] STORE                                                    
                                                                                                    
 Check every vote in the file, then add the new ones to the store.                                  
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮

│                                the docs for the fields).                                         │
│                                [required]                                                        │
│    --source              TEXT  The tool that collected them, recorded on each vote.              │
│    --skip-unknown              Leave out votes on outputs the store doesn't have, instead of     │
│                                refusing the file.                                                │
│    --dry-run                   Check every vote and say what would change; write nothing.        │
│    --help                      Show this message and exit.                                       │
