==> bench preferences rank --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench preferences rank [OPTIONS] STORE                                                      
                                                                                                    
 Ratings from the store's votes (also written to ratings.v1.json).                                  
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    store      PATH  The preference store `bench preferences pairs` made. [required]            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --by                     TEXT     Rate each agent, model, agent+model or condition.              │
│                                   [default: agent+model]                                         │
│ --bootstrap              INTEGER  Resamples for the 95% intervals (0: none). [default: 1000]     │
│ --seed                   INTEGER  Seed for the resampling. [default: 0]                          │
│ --min-agreement          FLOAT    Raw agreement (not kappa) to check the raters against (0 to    │
│                                   1); rank says whether it is met.                               │
│ --raters-per-pair        INTEGER  Raters each pair should have.                                  │
│ --raters                 TEXT     Whose votes to rate together: person, guest, model, or several │
│                                   joined by commas (default: people; the others get tables of    │
│                                   their own).                                                    │
│ --cluster                TEXT     What the intervals resample: vote, rater, task or rater+task   │
│                                   (auto: raters and tasks, when there are several of each).      │
│                                   [default: auto]                                                │
│ --provisional                     Show the ratings before every pair has a vote.                 │
│ --json                            Print JSON.                                                    │
│ --help                            Show this message and exit.                                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench bundle --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench bundle [OPTIONS] PATH                                                                 
                                                                                                    
 Write one zip of a run's evidence to share, redacted.                                              
                                                                                                    
 Per trial the result, trajectory, verifier output, reviews, regrades,                              
 artifacts and saved workspace; for a job its run card, summary and report.                         
 Every text file is redacted as a trajectory upload is. bundle.json lists                           
 each file with its SHA-256 and what was masked, and what was left out.                             
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  A job folder, or one trial folder inside it [required]                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --out        -o                    PATH  Where to write the zip (default: <PATH>.bundle.zip)     │
│ --workspace      --no-workspace          Include each trial's saved workspace (evidence/) when   │
│                                          it has one                                              │
│                                          [default: workspace]                                    │
│ --help                                   Show this message and exit.                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench skills eval --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench skills eval [OPTIONS] SKILL_DIR                                                       
                                                                                                    
 Evaluate a skill using its evals/evals.json test cases.                                            
                                                                                                    
 Generates ephemeral tasks from the skill's eval dataset, runs each agent                           
 with and without the skill installed, and reports the lift.                                        
                                                                                                    
 Examples:                                                                                          
     bench skills eval ./my-skill/ --agent claude-agent-acp                                         
     bench skills eval ./my-skill/ --agent claude-agent-acp --agent codex-acp --sandbox daytona     
 --concurrency 4                                                                                    
     bench skills eval ./my-skill/ --agent claude-agent-acp --no-baseline --export-gepa             
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    skill_dir      PATH  Path to skill directory containing evals/evals.json [required]         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --agent              TEXT     Agent(s) to evaluate (repeatable)                                  │
│ --model              TEXT     Model(s) (matched 1:1 with agents)                                 │
│ --sandbox            TEXT     Sandbox: docker, remote-docker, daytona, modal, apple-container,   │
│                               or agentcore                                                       │
│                               [default: docker]                                                  │
│ --concurrency        INTEGER  Max concurrent tasks [default: 1]                                  │
│ --jobs-dir           TEXT     Output directory for results [default: jobs]                       │
│ --no-baseline                 Skip baseline (without-skill) runs                                 │
│ --export-gepa                 Export GEPA-compatible traces                                      │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                        │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench skills validate --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench skills validate [OPTIONS] PATHS...                                                    
                                                                                                    
 Run static checks on skills: NVIDIA SkillEvaluator Tier 1 and SkillSpector.                        
                                                                                                    
 SkillEvaluator Tier 1 checks schema, version, PII, license, code                                   
 integrity, dependencies, Unicode smuggling, quality score and script                               
 lint. SkillSpector scans for security issues. Both run without LLM                                 
 calls; install them separately (see docs/judging/skill-evals.md). Exit 1 when a                    
 schema, security or dependency finding reaches --fail-on, or a checker                             
 fails to run.                                                                                      
                                                                                                    
 Examples:                                                                                          
     bench skills validate ./my-skill                                                               
     bench skills validate tasks/ --json > skill-checks.json                                        
     bench skills validate tasks/citation-check --fail-on critical -o reports                       
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    paths      PATHS...  Skill directories, or directories searched recursively for SKILL.md    │
│                           (e.g. a SkillsBench tasks/ folder)                                     │
│                           [required]                                                             │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --no-security                                      Skip the NVIDIA SkillSpector security scan    │
│ --fail-on               TEXT                       Exit 1 when a schema, security or dependency  │
│                                                    finding is at or above this severity:         │
│                                                    critical, high, medium, low, or never         │
│                                                    [default: high]                               │
│ --checks                TEXT                       Comma-separated SkillEvaluator Tier 1 checks  │
│                                                    (default:                                     │
│                                                    schema,version,pii,license,code-integrity,de… │
│ --min-score             INTEGER RANGE [0<=x<=100]  Quality score SkillEvaluator's quality check  │
│                                                    needs (default 70); advisory: changes         │
│                                                    SkillEvaluator's Tier 1 status, not the exit  │
│                                                    code                                          │
│ --output-dir    -o      PATH                       Keep each skill's raw JSON reports under      │
│                                                    DIR/<skill>/                                  │
│ --workers       -j      INTEGER RANGE [x>=1]       Skills checked in parallel [default: 4]       │
│ --max-findings          INTEGER RANGE [x>=0]       Blocking findings listed per skill (all are   │
│                                                    in --json)                                    │
│                                                    [default: 5]                                  │
│ --json                                             Print machine-readable JSON                   │
│ --help                                             Show this message and exit.                   │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Usage: bench traj upload [OPTIONS] [PATH]                                                          
                                                                                                    
 Inspect, redact, confirm, and upload trajectory JSONL.                                             
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│   path      [PATH]  Trajectory JSONL file, directory, or trial directory                         │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

│                                                                manifest (inferred from git when  │
│                                                                omitted)                          │
│ --source-id                          TEXT                      Stable contributor source         │
│                                                                identifier                        │
│ --repo             --no-repo                                   Tag the upload with the session's │
│                                                                repository (owner/name from its   │
│                                                                git remote) as the source id      │
│                                                                [default: repo]                   │
│ --workspace        --no-workspace                              Attach an explicitly selected     │
│                                                                workspace folder as a zip (use    │
│                                                                --workspace-dir or select a       │
│                                                                folder at the prompt; skipped     │
│                                                                over 1 GiB)                       │
│                                                                [default: workspace]              │
│ --workspace-dir                      PATH                      Workspace folder to attach        │
│                                                                instead of auto-detection         │
│ --direct                                                       Upload with local Azure           │
│                                                                credentials                       │
│ --container-url                      TEXT                      Azure container URL for --direct  │
│ --dry-run                                                      Validate and stage without        │
│                                                                uploading                         │
│ --preview-steps                      INTEGER RANGE [0<=x<=20]  Number of redacted trajectory     │
│                                                                steps to preview                  │
│                                                                [default: 5]                      │
│ --wait             --no-wait                                   After uploading, wait until the   │
│                                                                capture is verified in storage    │
│                                                                (BENCHFLOW_TRAJ_WAIT_SECONDS      │
│                                                                overrides the budget)             │
│                                                                [default: wait]                   │
│ --help                                                         Show this message and exit.       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench train convert --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench train convert [OPTIONS] JOBS_DIR                                                      
                                                                                                    
 Convert BenchFlow rollout artifacts into trainer-ready data.                                       
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    jobs_dir      PATH  BenchFlow rollout or jobs directory [required]                          │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *  --out                  -o                 PATH                   Output path: JSONL, or       │
│                                                                     parquet for verl-sft         │
│                                                                     [required]                   │
│    --format                                  TEXT                   Trainer format: prime-sft,   │
│                                                                     trl-sft, branch-tree (one    │
│                                                                     row per branch child: shared │
│                                                                     prefix, continuation,        │
│                                                                     reward, advantage), verl-sft │
│                                                                     (parquet for verl's          │
│                                                                     multi-turn SFT trainer),     │
│                                                                     skyrl-sft (rows for SkyRL's  │
│                                                                     SFT trainer) or              │
│                                                                     openenv-episodes (OpenEnv    │
│                                                                     episode records)             │
│                                                                     [default: prime-sft]         │
│    --pairs                                   PATH                   branch-tree only: also write │
│                                                                     one row per sibling pair     │
│                                                                     whose rewards differ         │
│                                                                     (chosen/rejected, margin) to │
│                                                                     this JSONL path              │
│    --pairs-any-request                                              branch-tree only: also pair  │
│                                                                     siblings that were asked     │
│                                                                     different things (default:   │
│                                                                     only siblings with the same  │
│                                                                     first user message)          │
│    --include-oracle                                                 branch-tree only: keep       │
│                                                                     oracle children as rows      │
│                                                                     (skipped by default; their   │
│                                                                     only message is the solution │
│                                                                     script's exit code)          │
│    --min-reward                              FLOAT                  Only include rows with       │
│                                                                     reward >= value              │
│    --row-mode                                [rollout|exchange]     rollout writes one row per   │
│                                                                     rollout; exchange writes one │
│                                                                     row per LLM exchange         │
│                                                                     [default: rollout]           │
│    --manifest                                PATH                   Optional conversion stats    │
│                                                                     JSON path                    │
│    --expected-rows                           INTEGER                Fail (before writing the     │
│                                                                     output file) unless exactly  │
│                                                                     this many rows would be      │
│                                                                     exported                     │
│    --canonical-selection                     PATH                   Restrict conversion to rows  │
│                                                                     selected by                  │
│                                                                     canonical-selection.json     │
│    --redact                   --no-redact                           Redact secrets while         │
│                                                                     exporting trainer JSONL. Use │
│                                                                     --no-redact only for private │
│                                                                     local SFT data when          │
│                                                                     preserving exact tool-call   │
│                                                                     argument tokens is required. │
│                                                                     [default: redact]            │
│    --context-policy                          [full|message-window]  TRL context handling: full   │
│                                                                     or tokenizer-aware           │
│                                                                     message-window               │
│                                                                     [default: full]              │
│    --tokenizer                               TEXT                   Tokenizer/model ID for TRL   │
│                                                                     message-window conversion    │
│    --tokenizer-revision                      TEXT                   Immutable tokenizer revision │
│                                                                     for TRL conversion           │
│    --max-length                              INTEGER                Maximum rendered length for  │
│                                                                     TRL message-window           │
│                                                                     conversion                   │
│    --subagent-rows                                                  Also write each Claude       │
│                                                                     subagent conversation as     │
│                                                                     separate rows tagged with    │
│                                                                     the spawning tool call. By   │
│                                                                     default rows contain the     │
│                                                                     parent agent's conversation  │
│                                                                     only.                        │
│    --reward-vector                                                  prime-sft/trl-sft: add       │
│                                                                     reward_vector to every row:  │
│                                                                     the test gate and each       │
│                                                                     rubric criterion (names,     │
│                                                                     kinds, weights, 0-1 values)  │
│                                                                     for rubric-scored trials,    │
│                                                                     else every numeric key the   │
│                                                                     verifier wrote. Unscored     │
│                                                                     rollouts get null.           │
│    --group-advantage                         TEXT                   prime-sft/trl-sft: add       │
│                                                                     advantage and group to every │
│                                                                     row, normalised over the     │
│                                                                     scored rollouts of the same  │
│                                                                     group: grpo = (r - mean) /   │
│                                                                     (std + 1e-4), sample std;    │
│                                                                     loo = r - mean of the        │
│                                                                     others. Unscored rollouts    │
│                                                                     get null, never 0.           │
│    --group-by                                TEXT                   Grouping key for             │
│                                                                     --group-advantage,           │
│                                                                     comma-separated from task,   │
│                                                                     agent, model, task_digest,   │
│                                                                     job. A group stays inside    │
│                                                                     one job unless job is left   │
│                                                                     out (jobs may have run       │
│                                                                     different policy             │
│                                                                     checkpoints)                 │
│                                                                     [default:                    │
│                                                                     task,agent,model,job]        │
│    --help                                                           Show this message and exit.  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench train token-coverage --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench train token-coverage [OPTIONS] PATH                                                   
                                                                                                    
 Report whether each rollout's model calls carry token ids and logprobs.                            
                                                                                                    
 Reads trajectory/llm_trajectory.jsonl token_capture blocks (see                                    
 docs/train/trainer.md#token-ids-and-logprobs). A rollout is training-grade when                    
 every call has prompt token ids, sampled token ids and logprobs, and                               
 each prompt extends the previous call's prompt and sampled tokens.                                 
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    path      PATH  BenchFlow rollout or jobs directory [required]                              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json          Print the report as JSON                                                         │
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯


==> bench train stream --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench train stream [OPTIONS] JOB_DIR                                                        
                                                                                                    
 Print each finished rollout of a (running) job as one JSON line.                                   
                                                                                                    
 For a trainer that consumes a job while it runs: every line is a                                   
 benchflow.rollout-stream.v1 record with the reward, group id and,                                  
 when the gateway captured them, per-call token ids and logprobs                                    
 (docs/train/trainer.md#stream-rollouts-while-a-job-runs). Status goes to stderr. Exit 0            
 when the job finished, 1 when it was stopped or its process died                                   
 first, 2 on bad input, 3 on --timeout.                                                             
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    job_dir      PATH  Job folder (or a --jobs-dir holding one job); may not exist yet          │
│                         [required]                                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --format                          TEXT     Output format: jsonl [default: jsonl]                 │
│ --follow           --no-follow             Keep polling until the job finishes (default), or     │
│                                            scan once                                             │
│                                            [default: follow]                                     │
│ --poll-interval                   FLOAT    Seconds between scans [default: 1.0]                  │
│ --timeout                         FLOAT    Stop after this many seconds (exit 3)                 │
│ --group-size                      INTEGER  Hold rollouts until N of a group finished, then emit  │
│                                            them with a GRPO advantage                            │
│ --group-by                        TEXT     Grouping key, comma-separated from task, agent,       │
│                                            model, task_digest, job (default                      │
│                                            task,agent,model,job)                                 │
│ --withheld                        PATH     --group-size: write the records of groups withheld    │
│                                            from the trainer (a member unscored or without the    │
│                                            others' token sequence, or the group still short at   │
│                                            the end) to this JSONL file, each with its reason     │
│ --help                                     Show this message and exit.                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 Usage: bench hub [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

==> bench embodied verify --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench embodied verify [OPTIONS] JOB_DIR                                                     
                                                                                                    
 Check each trial's files against its verdict now: record hashes, video copies, reward vs the       
 record.                                                                                            
                                                                                                    
 It catches files edited, added or mixed up after the trial. It doesn't re-run the simulator, and   
 it can't tell who wrote the folder.                                                                
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    job_dir      PATH  A job folder (jobs/<job>: every run in it) or one run                    │
│                         (jobs/<job>/<time>)                                                      │
│                         [required]                                                               │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --json          Print the checks as JSON                                                         │
│ --help          Show this message and exit.                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

==> bench continue --help <==
                                                                                                    
 Usage: bench continue [OPTIONS] FOLDER                                                             
                                                                                                    
 (deprecated)                                                                                       
 Resume a previous unfinished (timed-out) OpenHands run to completion.                              
                                                                                                    
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    folder      PATH  Original run output folder (contains config.json +                        │
│                        trajectory/llm_trajectory.jsonl).                                         │
│                        [required]                                                                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --tasks-dir                                      PATH     Directory holding the task source      │
│                                                           (instruction + verifier). Required     │
│                                                           unless the recorded task_path still    │
│                                                           exists on disk.                        │
│ --model                                          TEXT     Override the live-continuation model   │
│                                                           (default: the original run's model).   │
│ --timeout                                        INTEGER  Wall-clock budget for the              │
│                                                           continuation, in seconds (default: the │
│                                                           original run's timeout).               │
│ --output                                         PATH     Output jobs dir for the new run        │
│                                                           (default: <orig-parent>/continued).    │
│ --require-timeout      --no-require-timeout               Refuse runs whose recorded status is   │
│                                                           not a timeout.                         │
│                                                           [default: no-require-timeout]          │
│ --strict-divergence    --no-strict-divergence             Abort if replay leaves the original    │
│                                                           rails (message-count mismatch) instead │
│                                                           of warning.                            │
│                                                           [default: no-strict-divergence]        │
│ --replay-only          --no-replay-only                   Rebuild the env via replay and stop at │
│                                                           the cut-point (no live model needed) — │
│                                                           useful for testing.                    │
│                                                           [default: no-replay-only]              │
│ --proxy-mode                                     TEXT     Replay proxy placement: auto, host, or │
│                                                           sandbox. Auto uses sandbox-local       │
│                                                           replay for Daytona/Modal and host      │
│                                                           replay for Docker.                     │
│                                                           [default: auto]                        │
│ --help                                                    Show this message and exit.            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

│ --name                  TEXT  Benchmark slug (default: from source)                              │
│ --model                 TEXT  Model for the codex driver                                         │
│ --dry-run                     Print the launch command, do not run                               │
│ --codex-bin             TEXT  Host codex binary [default: codex]                                 │
│ --codex-config  -c      TEXT  Codex config override as key=value, passed to codex as `-c         │
│                               key=value`; repeatable (e.g. -c service_tier=flex to work around   │
│                               host ~/.codex/config.toml drift)                                   │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                                        │
